Title: Director, Delivery CX AI
Description:
**Director, CX AI Delivery**
**Who We Are**
Welcome to TELUS Digital — where innovation drives impact at a global scale. As an award-winning digital product consultancy and the digital division of TELUS, one of Canada’s largest telecommunications providers, we design and deliver transformative customer experiences through cutting-edge technology, agile thinking, and a people-first culture
  
  
With a global team across North America, South America, Central America, Europe, Africa, and APAC, we offer end-to-end expertise across eight core service areas: Digital Product Consulting, Digital Marketing Services, Data & AI, Strategy Consulting, Business Operations Modernization, Enterprise Applications, Cloud Engineering, and QA & Test Engineering.
  
  
From mobile apps and websites to voice UI, chatbots, AI, customer service, and in-store solutions, TELUS Digital enables seamless, trusted, and digitally powered experiences that meet customers wherever they are — all backed by the secure infrastructure and scale of our multi-billion-dollar parent company.
  
  
**Location & Flexibility**
This role will operate remotely in the
**United States**
or
**Canada**
OR be based out of one of our major North American office locations - Charlottesville, VA, Durham, NC, Columbus, OH, Boston, MA, Toronto, ON, or Vancouver, BC.
  
  
This role may involve travel of up to 25% to contact center and client locations.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are seeking a
**Director, CX AI Delivery**
: a consultant and delivery expert who can turn complex contact center and AI programs into predictable, measurable outcomes. You will lead delivery across our CX AI portfolio, spanning Contact Center as a Service (CCaaS) platforms, conversational and agentic AI, agent assist, and CX intelligence, and serve as a trusted advisor to client executives. You will manage a portfolio of client engagements (generally ~$15–20M in revenue), directly lead delivery, product, and engineering leaders, and step in to stabilize and recover programs when needed.
  
  
This is a delivery-first leadership role with an AI lens. You will bring the rigor of a seasoned delivery executive together with a working command of how AI is changing CX: from AI-driven routing and virtual agents to copilots, knowledge, and agentic automation. You will help clients adopt these capabilities responsibly, at scale, and in iterative releases that get value into production quickly. You will also help evaluate vendor and partner solutions and decide how and when new tools enter the ecosystem.
  
  
This position reports to the Managing Director, CX AI Delivery and typically manages 8–12 direct reports, including senior managers, managers, and principal-level delivery and technical leaders. It is primarily evaluated on delivery success, client and team feedback, forecast accuracy, portfolio profitability, and growth of key accounts. This is an opportunistically billable position.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Strategic Account Governance & Growth**

* Be the executive partner. Act as the primary escalation point and strategic advisor for client executives, ensuring TELUS Digital is viewed as a “Doctor” (consultative partner), not a “Waiter” (order taker).
* Run portfolio health. Drive the commercial success of a ~$15–20M portfolio, leading Quarterly Business Reviews that connect delivery progress to the client’s long-term CX and business goals.
* Grow organically. Identify expansion opportunities in existing accounts by understanding client pain points and bringing a relevant point of view on CX and AI. Support renewals, upsell, and expansion in partnership with strategic sales and customer success teams.
* Extend into managed services and advisory as the practice matures: shape Day 2 support models, operational readiness, and advisory engagements that keep clients engaged after go-live.

**Delivery Excellence & Risk Mitigation**

* Lead a global, multidisciplinary team across multiple concurrent workstreams, ensuring product, engineering, and delivery leaders operate as a cohesive unit to deliver measurable outcomes.
* Manage risk proactively. Identify “red” and “yellow” programs early; step into recovery situations to provide clarity, reset expectations, and stabilize teams and client relationships.
* Push for iterative delivery. Favor smaller releases and faster cycles over big-bang launches, especially for AI capabilities where learning in production is essential.
* Optimize delivery models, balancing onshore/offshore teams, automation, and repeatable assets to improve margins and scalability.
* Manage vendor and partner ecosystems. Work with CCaaS and AI platform partners (e.g., Genesys, Google, AWS, Zendesk, Five9, ElevenLabs, Cresta, Parloa) to deliver joint solutions as well as surrounding services in the client ecosystem.
* Partner on pre-sales. Support the commercial team to shape innovative solutions and lead scoping, estimation, and handoffs into delivery so engagements start with clear requirements and goals.

**Leadership & Talent Development**

* Coach and mentor delivery, product, and engineering leaders on leading their own teams and navigating complex client dynamics.
* Build a high-performance culture with regular 1:1s and performance reviews grounded in radical candor and growth, delivering feedback upward, across, and down with grace and clarity.
* Raise the bar on talent. Participate in senior-level hiring, contribute to the Delivery Playbook, and build career paths and skill development (including AI and platform certification pipelines).

**Operational & Financial Stewardship**

* Own portfolio financials: gross margin, utilization, and effective billable rates.
* Forecast accurately. Maintain precise revenue and resource forecasts so the business can plan hiring and growth with confidence.
* Influence with data. Use reporting language, data visualization, and storytelling to influence internal and external decisions and inspire confidence in stakeholders.
* Collaborate across the business with peers and practice leaders to improve internal processes and operational efficiency, and bring energy to moments that matter: new relationships, key presentations, and recovery situations.

**Qualifications**

* 10+ years in the technology industry, including 4+ years in a senior leadership role in a professional services, consulting, or agency environment.
* Proven record managing a diverse portfolio of client accounts (ideally $10M+ in annual revenue) with a focus on retention and organic growth.
* Experience delivering large-scale CX or contact center transformations that influenced VP- and C-level decision making.
* Working knowledge of how AI is applied in CX: conversational and voice AI, agent assist and copilots, AI-driven routing, knowledge and content for AI, and CX intelligence; ability to discuss architecture, risk, and ROI credibly with both technical and executive audiences.
* Hands-on delivery experience with one or more leading CCaaS or CX AI platforms (e.g., Genesys, Amazon Connect, Zendesk, Google); platform certifications and experience across multiple verticals are a plus.
* Deep understanding of the SDLC and Agile delivery, with a track record of leading complex, custom-built software solutions from discovery to launch, and comfort with iterative, experiment-driven delivery.
* Experience managing and coaching leaders across Product, Engineering, and Delivery, and leading large, globally distributed teams.
* Strong command of professional services metrics, including gross margin, utilization, forecast accuracy, and effective billable rates.
* Exceptional ability to navigate “recovery situations” and high-stakes client conversations with poise, clarity, and a solution-oriented mindset.
* Ability to translate complex delivery data into compelling narratives for QBRs and executive stakeholders.
* Understanding of regulatory requirements in contact center operations (e.g., PCI, HIPAA, TCPA, PIPEDA) is a plus.

Description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

AWS Canada is looking for a Customer Success Manager (CSM) to join our Independent Software Vendor (ISV) team, a role at the intersection of technology strategy, business transformation, and customer partnership.  
  
You will own the success of a portfolio of Canadian ISVs navigating multi-year cloud, SaaS, and AI transformation journeys. Your job is to ensure these companies don't just adopt AWS; they build competitive advantage on it. That means helping them migrate critical workloads, accelerate AI and agentic capability adoption, and translate their technology investments into measurable business outcomes.  
  
In this role you are connecting ISV customers to the right AWS expertise, programs, and teams at the right time, and holding the thread across complex, multi-stakeholder environments.  
  
If you thrive where technical depth and business strategy intersect, and you want your work to have visible, lasting impact on how Canada's most innovative software companies grow, then this role is for you.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Drive Customer Outcomes  

* Own the success of a portfolio of ISV accounts, working backwards from each customer's strategic milestones to define and execute a clear path to value realization
* Lead roadmap-to-outcome alignment sessions,
* Executive Briefing Sessions, and go-live milestones that accelerate each customer's cloud and AI journey
* Help ISVs build the governance, operating models, and data infrastructure needed to sustain long-term transformation, not just hit short-term milestones
* Support customers in adopting generative AI and agentic capabilities that are reshaping how software is built, delivered, and monetized

  
Orchestrate Across AWS  

* Serve as the connective tissue between ISV customers and AWS teams (Sales, Solutions Architecture, Support, Professional Services, and Partner teams) ensuring coordinated, high-quality engagement
* Contribute to account planning, translating strategic goals into executable actions with clear ownership and timelines
* Identify and remove systemic barriers that slow customer progress, escalating with precision and urgency when needed

  
Lead Strategic Engagements  

* Lead director-level engagements, co-innovation workshops, and strategic planning sessions with Product, Engineering, and Technology leadership within ISV accounts
* Help translate complex AI and cloud solutions into business cases for senior stakeholders, bridging the gap between technical teams and executive decision-makers
* Support customers through critical decision points: workload migration sequencing, AI adoption strategy, SaaS architecture evolution

  
Manage with Rigor  

* Maintain structured cadence through reporting, tracking, and health monitoring across your portfolio
* Apply structured delivery mechanisms and measurement frameworks to ensure customers realize the value of their AWS investment
* Proactively identify risks (technical, organizational, or commercial) and drive mitigation plans before they become escalations

  
Raise the Bar Internally  

* Challenge conventional thinking and take initiative on customer challenges, bringing new ideas, tools, and mechanisms to problems
* Bring the best of AWS and Amazon to customers, proactively solving problems by connecting them to emerging capabilities, programs, and expertise they may not know exist
* Contribute to repeatable mechanisms and internal enablement, sharing learnings from your customer engagements to help raise the bar for how AWS delivers customer success in Canada.

  
About the team  
You don't need to build cloud infrastructure, but you need to understand it well enough to earn the trust of the engineers who do.  
  
On any given day, you might help a VP/Director of Product at a Canadian SaaS company understand the business case for migrating their core platform to AWS, facilitate an alignment session between an ISV's engineering team and AWS Solutions Architecture, or work with your internal team to unblock a stalled migration that's at risk of missing its go-live milestone.  
  
You'll be working with some of Canada's most innovative software companies at a pivotal moment, when AI is fundamentally changing how software is built, delivered, and monetized. If you thrive in environments where technical depth and clear communication are equally valued, this role is for you.

------------------------

* Experience leading large-scale, technical or engineering programs with a proven record of thought leadership, business case development, realizing customer benefits, and successful program completion
* Experience in customer-facing work, engaging with customer executives, technologists or partners to solve business problems with advanced technologies
* 5+ years of IT and/or Management Consulting experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Cloud Technology Certification, or AWS certification, such as, AWS Solutions Architect, or a similar cloud certification
* Experience architecting, migrating, transforming or modernizing customer requirements to the cloud

* Drive continuous improvement of HSE processes and performance.

* Extensive experience with HSE inspections, audits, and regulatory compliance.
* Strong knowledge of risk assessments, hazard identification, and permit-to-work systems.
* Experience leading incident investigations and root cause analysis.
* Strong understanding of emergency preparedness and incident response.
* Experience monitoring and reporting HSE KPIs, including LTIFR, TRIR, HIPO events, and near misses.
* Strong leadership, stakeholder management, coaching, and communication skills.

* CMIOSH – Chartered Member of IOSH.
* Experience on hyperscale data center or mission-critical projects.
* Familiarity with ISO 45001 Occupational Health & Safety Management Systems.
* Familiarity with ISO 14001 Environmental Management Systems.
* Experience using electronic HSE reporting and incident management systems.
* Knowledge of contractor HSE management and safety leadership programs.
* Experience developing executive HSE dashboards and KPI reports.

--------------------

-------------------------

The Client Business Executive is accountable for the end-to-end CSS business within the assigned customer unit or cluster. The role owns the business agenda across pre-sales, solution positioning, sales execution, delivery alignment, customer satisfaction, and profitable growth.

As the primary CSS business leader toward the Cluster Heads, the Client Business Executive translates customer and business priorities into clear growth strategies, investment decisions, execution plans, and measurable outcomes. **What You Will Bring**
-----------------------

* Proven experience managing complex customer engagements across sales, pre-sales, delivery, and the customer lifecycle.

* Ability to engage credibly with C-level and senior customer stakeholders.
* Strong consultative selling, negotiation, presentation, influencing, and relationship-building skills.
* Proven ability to make sound, timely decisions across competing business, customer, delivery, and commercial priorities.

Success will be measured by the Client Business Executive’s ability to:

* Deliver sustainable and profitable CSS growth.
* Strengthen executive-level customer relationships and customer confidence.
* Improve alignment between pre-sales, sales, delivery, and service operations.
* Increase pipeline quality, conversion, retention, upsell, and cross-sell performance.
* Improve delivery predictability, customer satisfaction, and value realization.
* Build a high-performing, accountable, and collaborative CSS leadership culture.
* Establish CSS as a strategic business partner to the customer—not only as a delivery or support function.

This role is not limited to account relationship management, opportunity coordination, or operational delivery oversight. It is an end-to-end business leadership role with accountability for shaping, growing, governing, and delivering the CSS business across the customer lifecycle.

The Client Business Executive operates in close partnership with the KAM and account organization but owns the CSS business agenda, ensuring that customer needs, commercial priorities, solution positioning, and delivery execution are connected into one integrated business approach.

Title: Director, Cybersecurity
Description:
Strengthen the security resilience of one of the few environments where research, clinical care, and hospital operations converge. As a Director, Cybersecurity at Sinai Health, you will lead the tactical and operational work needed to turn an established security roadmap into lasting safeguards. This is a hands-on leadership role where you actively steer risk assessments, security operations, and technical controls alongside team members and external partners. You will pair advanced security tooling and industry-leading partners to protect corporate systems, health services, personal information (PI), personal health information (PHI), research data and intellectual property. Few sectors face the scale, complexity and potential consequences of cyber threats that healthcare does. Your work keeps those systems safe preserving the trust of the communities we serve.
  
  
Is this you?
  
Bringing people together around a shared goal is how you advance risk posture across complex environments. Cybersecurity is a shared responsibility that no single team can carry alone, so the relationships you build matter as much as the controls you put in place. Working in close collaboration with IT, privacy, clinical, and corporate teams allows you to apply security controls in ways that support everyday work. Whether you are shaping a new policy or rolling out a control, you build support across teams by showing how it protects the work they already care about. The shared ownership you cultivate helps a culture of security take root across the organization.
  
Are you proactive about keeping current about new technologies and emerging threats? This field moves quickly, so staying effective means understanding what’s trending and what it means for the systems you protect. Industry research, threat intelligence, and strong partner relationships keep you informed about where the field is heading. Whether you are evaluating a new tool or a vendor’s latest offering, you weigh the investment against the organization’s needs and priorities to ensure it’s the right use of our investments and time. The knowledge you build keeps the organization ahead of emerging threats and keeps you growing as a professional.
  
A practical command of security technology gives you a clear understanding of how systems behave. This is a role where you work with the systems yourself, so your knowledge stays current and applied. Whether you are reviewing how access is configured in the Epic electronic health record platform or tuning the detection rules behind your monitoring, you are at ease working in the technology directly. This is where deep technical skill and senior leadership reinforce each other, keeping you engaged with the technology on a daily basis.
  
Strong problem-solving skills are essential in a role like this, where the decisions you face rarely come with an obvious answer. This position sits at the point where business priorities and technical demands converge, requiring someone with the confidence and critical thinking to arrive at solutions that work for both. The impact of your judgment extends well beyond the security team, shapes outcomes that matter across the whole organization, making your work widely visible.
  
  
**In this role you will:**  

* Lead the development and maintenance of information security policies and standards, owning and maintaining the enterprise cyber risk register and governance framework
* Lead compliance activities under PHIPA and the Ontario Cyber Security Framework/Regulation, coordinating evidence collection, control testing, and gap remediation
* Integrate cyber governance, risk, and compliance activities with other hospital risk management and advisory functions, including Enterprise Risk Management, Privacy, Legal, and Internal Audit, to ensure a coordinated approach to risk, incident response, and regulatory obligations
* Prepare and present risk and compliance reporting for various committees, senior leadership, and internal/external auditors
* Lead third-party risk assessments from a governance perspective, including privacy and contractual risk considerations, in partnership with Procurement, Privacy, and Legal
* Own and mature the cyber threat and vulnerability risk management program, including threat intelligence, threat management tools and risk-mitigation processes
* Direct prioritization, tracking, and reporting of vulnerability and threat remediation across endpoints, servers, network, and cloud/SaaS environments

Description:
Over 50,000 customers globally trust our end-to-end, cloud-driven networking solutions. They rely on our top-rated services and support to accelerate their digital transformation efforts and deliver unprecedented progress. With double-digit growth year over year, no provider is better positioned to deliver scalable outcomes than Extreme.

  

Inclusion is one of our core values and in our DNA. We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that embraces our differences and creates an atmosphere where all our employees thrive because of their differences, not in spite of them.

  

Become part of Something big with Extreme! As a global networking leader, learn why there’s no better time to join the Extreme team.

  

**Job Description**

  

What you will do (Job Specific Details on the nature of the job and responsibilities).

  

**Title of position** : Program Manager

**Position type:** Full time

**Location** : Canada

**Position reports to** : Director of Program Management

**Application deadline** : Applications are being accepted on a rolling basis and this posting will remain open until filled.

**Work authorization** : We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa, including H-1B visas/Work permits at this time

  

**Job Description** :

  

The **Technical Program Manager** will join the Project Management Office and drive a complex, multi-year strategic government program involving hardware platform NPI, concurrent software releases, private cloud infrastructure deployment, and international compliance certification. The role requires strong technical program management skills, disciplined execution, executive stakeholder management, and the ability to coordinate across Hardware Engineering, Firmware Development, Networking Software (cloud management, security, controller platforms), QA, Product Management, Manufacturing, International Compliance, and government customer teams across multiple time zones.

  

The individual will own program visibility and governance, identify and drive resolution of complex cross-functional dependencies across multiple teams and workstreams, ensure customer commitments are met, manage compliance/certification critical paths, maintain executive stakeholder alignment, and escalate risks early with clear impact analysis and mitigation options.

  

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

  

**Executive Stakeholder Management & Program Governance**

* Own program governance structure; establish and maintain executive steering committee cadence with clear decision-making authority
* Provide weekly executive reporting on program health, milestone status, critical risks, and pending decisions
* Communicate program status to SVP-level leadership and customer steering committee with clear, actionable insights
* Escalate risks and resource conflicts to leadership with impact analysis, mitigation options, and recommended actions
* Ensure executive visibility into program timeline, customer commitments, and go/no-go readiness
Manage executive decision-making on trade-offs (scope vs. schedule vs. quality) with full context  

**Release & Program Management**

* Manage multiple concurrent software and hardware release programs across cloud management, security, controller, networking software, and manufacturing components
* Drive releases through development completion, QA, release readiness, and GA milestones
* Track release scope, feature readiness, must-fix defects, testing completion, and release criteria
* Lead release readiness meetings, ensuring actions, risks, dependencies, and decisions are documented
* Ensure release artifacts (release notes, technical documentation, customer guides) are completed before GA
Identify schedule risks early and drive mitigation plans with responsible teams  

  

**Hardware NPI & Manufacturing Coordination**

* Manage new hardware platform NPI program through development, manufacturing, QA verification, and GA
* Track development, firmware/image readiness, QA verification, manufacturing readiness, and GA milestones
* Ensure hardware engineering and software feature commitments remain aligned with manufacturing timeline
* Coordinate hardware-firmware-software dependencies required for platform launch
* Drive BOM finalization, manufacturing-image readiness, and ODM partner coordination to ensure hardware ships with appropriate firmware
Coordinate dependencies across Hardware Engineering, Firmware, Software teams, Manufacturing, ODM partners, and other supporting organizations  

  

**Quality & Defect Management**

* Participate in recurring defect/bug scrubs across multiple software platforms and hardware validation
* Track must-fix defects and ensure critical issues are resolved before release
* Work with Engineering and QA to prioritize defects based on release impact and schedule
* Monitor automated and manual test results; escalate failures threatening release readiness
Ensure comprehensive end-to-end testing for features spanning multiple platforms (cloud management, security, controller, networking software)  

  

**Dependency, Risk & Escalation Management**

* Maintain visibility into complex cross-functional dependencies across multiple teams and workstreams
* Proactively identify schedule, resource, technical, testing, compliance, and manufacturing risks
* Maintain centralized risk register with probability/impact assessment and mitigation tracking
* Drive owners toward resolution of blocking issues rather than simply reporting status
* Escalate unresolved risks and resource conflicts to leadership with clear impact, options, and recommended actions
* Coordinate commitments when multiple programs compete for shared Engineering or QA resources
Ensure critical dependencies have clearly defined owners, dates, and closure criteria  

  

**International Compliance & Certification Management**

* Coordinate compliance deliverables required for government product release
* Track regulatory and international compliance dependencies (FCC, CE, telecom certifications, government security requirements)
* Ensure compliance requirements and certifications do not block customer deployment
* Coordinate dependencies involving external certification bodies and ODM partners
* Track certification timelines and identify delays or blockers early
Assess and communicate release impact of delayed certifications or compliance deliverables  

  

**Program Tracking & Reporting**

* Maintain accurate program plans, milestones, dependencies, risks, and status using Jira and portfolio management tools
* Use Jira epics, features, defects, and dashboards to assess program health across all workstreams
* Develop concise program status reports for PMO and executive leadership
* Clearly communicate milestone health, risks, decisions required, and leadership attention areas
* Use AI tools to generate automated reports, trend analysis, and program health dashboards
* Leverage AI-driven monitoring tools to track program metrics and flag risks proactively
* Manage program coordination and reporting across multiple time zones to support global teams and customers

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* **5+ years** of experience in Technical Program Management, Project Management, or Engineering Program Management in technology organizations
* **Demonstrated experience** managing complex hardware NPI programs (design through manufacturing, QA, GA)
* **Demonstrated experience** managing concurrent software releases across multiple platforms with independent release cadences
* **Strong understanding** of software development lifecycle (development, integration, QA, defect management, release readiness, GA)
* **Strong understanding** of hardware NPI lifecycle (design, manufacturing, BOM, image readiness, production ramp, GA)
* **Experience coordinating** programs involving Hardware Engineering, Firmware Development, Software teams (cloud, security, controller), QA, Product Management, Manufacturing, Compliance, and other cross-functional organizations
* **Strong experience** managing milestones, dependencies, risks, and critical-path activities across multiple concurrent programs
* **Demonstrated ability** to drive teams toward committed dates without direct management authority
* **Experience leading** release-readiness meetings, program reviews, defect reviews, and cross-functional working sessions
* **Executive communication experience** – ability to present program status, risks, and recommendations to VP/SVP-level leadership
* **Program governance experience** – ability to establish program decision-making structures and executive steering committees
* **Strong Jira experience** including epics, features, defects, dashboards, queries, and program tracking
* **Strong written and verbal communication** skills with ability to communicate effectively with technical teams and senior leadership
* **Demonstrated ability** to recognize when a program is at risk, determine underlying cause, establish action plan, and escalate appropriately
* **Risk management experience** – ability to identify, assess, prioritize, and track mitigation of program risks
* **Ability to operate** effectively in fast-moving environment with multiple simultaneous releases and changing priorities
* **Experience managing** programs with resource support across multiple time zones
* **Ability to use various AI tools** to generate reports, analyze program data, monitor program metrics, and identify trends

  

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* **Experience** in networking, enterprise infrastructure, cloud-managed platforms, or telecommunications
* **Experience** managing programs that combine hardware, firmware/software, cloud services, and management/control applications
* **Experience** with hardware NPI including manufacturing readiness, BOM management, software-image readiness, and ODM/OEM partner coordination
* **Familiarity** with international product compliance processes (FCC, CE, country-specific certifications)
* **Familiarity** with government or regulated-industry customer procurement processes and approval workflows
* **Experience** managing cloud platform deployments, controller-based software releases, and private infrastructure configurations
* **Experience** managing programs with international customer bases and multi-time zone coordination
* **Proficiency** with AI-driven program management and analytics tools for reporting and monitoring
* **PMP, PgMP, Agile/Scrum,** or comparable project/program management certification

  

**KEY CHARACTERISTICS FOR SUCCESS**

The strongest candidate will be **execution-oriented** rather than primarily administrative. This person should be comfortable going deep enough into technical programs to understand what is blocking hardware development, software integration, manufacturing readiness, or compliance certification; challenging dates or assumptions when necessary; and driving teams toward resolution.

They should be able to simultaneously manage hardware NPI and multiple concurrent software releases while maintaining clear understanding of what must happen, who owns it, when it must happen, what dependencies exist, what could cascade delays, and what needs leadership attention.

Success in this role requires:

* **Strong ownership** – Takes responsibility for program health, governance, and escalation
* **Executive presence** – Communicates with confidence to senior leadership; gains executive trust and credibility
* **Persistence** – Drives resolution of blocking issues rather than accepting "will figure it out later"
* **Organization** – Manages complex cross-functional dependencies with clear visibility and accountability
* **Technical curiosity** – Understands hardware/firmware/software/cloud complexity without being engineer-level deep
* **Sound judgment** – Knows when to escalate vs. when to absorb a risk; makes trade-off recommendations with confidence
* **Risk acumen** – Proactively identifies program risks and develops mitigation strategies; communicates risk trajectory to leadership
* **Influence without authority** – Drives Hardware, Firmware, Software, QA, Manufacturing teams toward aligned commitments
* **Global perspective** – Comfortable coordinating across time zones and managing distributed teams
* **AI adoption mindset** – Comfortable leveraging AI tools to enhance reporting, analysis, and decision-making

Title: Delivery Program Director
Description:
Position Overview:

We are creating a new leadership role that brings Customer Success and Product Support together under one owner.

On the Customer Success side, you will be accountable for the full client experience after contract signature, from onboarding and go live through adoption, satisfaction and renewal.

On the Support side, you will have direct responsibility for the Product Support team and overall accountability for support service excellence. This includes defining support processes, driving continuous improvement initiatives, and coordinating with shared support and maintenance functions to ensure seamless collaboration and the delivery of reliable 24/7 customer support within SLA targets.

Your mandate is simple to state and demanding to deliver: every client should be well supported, getting real value from our products, and happy to recommend us. You will build the Customer Success function largely from the ground up, give the business a clear, data driven view of client health and raise the standard of our support operation.

The role is deliberately hands-on in the first year. Alongside building the team and the operating model, you will personally manage key customer relationships, lead critical escalations and work directly with the support team on day-to-day operations until the new processes and team are fully established.

Responsibilities:

**Lead Product Support**

* Define and run support processes covering triage, prioritization, SLAs, incident and problem management, root cause analysis and knowledge management, in close alignment with SaaS Operations and Engineering.
* Improve the speed and quality of incident and problem management, as well as how customers perceive it.
* Use monitoring, data and AI to move support from reactive to proactive, increasing self service and first contact resolution.
* Build a support model that scales with the customer base.

**Build and run the Customer Success function**

* Define and run the customer success operating model: customer segmentation and coverage, engagement playbooks, a common account plan and a customer health score.
* Set the rhythm of customer engagement, including onboarding reviews, regular service reviews, executive business reviews and renewal planning.
* Build a joint customer success model across SBS product lines and regions.

**Orchestrate the customer experience**

* Act as the single point of accountability for the customer experience across Support, Customer Success and delivery teams.
* Ensure customer experience responsiveness, predictability and transparency on incidents, releases and roadmap commitments.
* Own escalation management, personally leading critical escalations through to resolution and clear communication with the client.
* Work with Professional Services to ensure a smooth handover from project to run, so every go live lands well.

**Elevate customer satisfaction and retention**

* Run proactive health reviews and early risk detection, with clear recovery plans for accounts at risk.
* Own the voice of the customer: CSAT and NPS programs, app store ratings and structured feedback loops into Product.
* Contribute to the SBS Customer Satisfaction Program and embed the Golden Disciplines across customer-facing teams.
* Protect renewals by working with Account Managers well ahead of renewal dates, so there are no surprises.

**Maximize product adoption and realized value**

* Track usage and adoption across products and modules, and identify underused features and adoption gaps.
* Run adoption plans with customers to unlock more of the value they have already bought.
* Measure and demonstrate tangible ROI to client executives through regular value reviews.
* Bring structured customer insight into roadmap prioritization with Product Leaders.

**Surface growth opportunities**

* Identify new use cases, additional modules and upgrade opportunities within the installed base.
* Channel qualified upsell and expansion leads to Account Managers, and build a pipeline originated by the CSM team over time.

Qualifications:

* At least 10 years in enterprise software or fintech, including at least 5 years leading Customer Success, Support or Service Delivery teams.
* Strong track record in banking or financial services software, ideally in digital banking, open banking, payments or lending.
* Experience managing both SaaS and customer managed (on premise) clients, including SLA governance and major incident management.
* Credible with bank executives and comfortable leading difficult conversations when things go wrong.
* Experience across the Middle East and Africa, ideally with exposure to the US and Europe. Knowledge of the GCC banking market is a strong plus.
* Comfortable working in a matrix organization and influencing teams that do not report directly to them.
* Hands-on leader who can operate at executive level while confidently diving into the operational and technical details as required.
* Commercially astute, technically capable, and credible in banking conversations with both business and technology stakeholders.

Skills

* Operational discipline and a data driven approach to managing a client portfolio.
* Working knowledge of ITIL practices, support tooling such as Jira Service Management or ServiceNow, and customer success platforms such as Gainsight or equivalent.
* Technical enough to engage with Engineering on root causes across APIs, cloud platforms and mobile applications.
* Genuine interest in using AI and automation to improve support and customer success at scale.
* Strong understanding of banking operations, banking products and the realities of running software in regulated financial institutions.
* Clear, confident communicator in writing and in person.
* Fluent English. French or Arabic is an advantage.

Education

* Degree in business, engineering, computer science or a related field. ITIL or customer success certification is a plus.

Title: Digital Product Manager
Description:
**Job Requisition ID:** 182879

About Al-Futtaim
  
Established in the 1930s, Al-Futtaim is one of the most diversified and progressive privately held regional businesses, headquartered in Dubai. Operating across more than 20 countries, the Group spans automotive, financial services, real estate, retail and health. With more than 40,000 employees, Al-Futtaim represents over 200 of the world’s most recognised brands, including Toyota, Lexus, IKEA, ACE and Marks & Spencer. Driven by its purpose to enrich lives and elevate communities, Al-Futtaim focuses on digital innovation, AI, sustainable growth and strategic partnerships, creating long-term value for customers, communities and partners while building a responsible legacy for future generations.

This role plays a critical part in executing IKEA's AI and digital transformation strategy, focusing on leveraging the latest technology to deliver cost-effective solutions. * Lead and develop highly effective project/product teams.
* Direct resources and assign tasks to manage one or more direct reports effectively.

#### **Technical Expertise**

* Demonstrate innovation and solutioning using Customer experience mapping and technical engineering knowledge.

* Coordinate activities, including virtual collaboration, to achieve business objectives.

#### **Performance Management**

At Al-Futtaim Retail, we are part of a 90-year legacy built on ambition, progress and long-term vision. Join us and be part of The Heart of Tomorrow.

Title: Senior Delivery Manager
Description:
Robots & Pencils is an applied AI engineering firm building the next frontier of business architecture. We design and ship AI co-workers that integrate into enterprise operations and deliver measurable results for our clients. We're all in on AWS, combining deep UX capability with senior engineering talent to get AI into production fast and keep it there.  
We've earned the trust of leaders across Consumer Products and Retail, Education, Energy, Financial Services, Healthcare, and Manufacturing and more, and earned a reputation as the nimble alternative to traditional global systems integrators. Founded in 2009, with delivery centers in Canada, the United States, Eastern Europe, and Latin America, we are smaller, faster, and more senior by design. Our teams average 15+ years of experience. We move fast, sweat the details, and build things that actually ship.

**Position Overview**

As a Senior Delivery Manager, you are the senior delivery authority on a cross-functional engagement: owning execution from kickoff through release, leading distributed onshore-and-offshore teams, and serving as the primary delivery partner to the client. You bring the judgment to navigate ambiguity, the discipline to keep complex programs on track, and the instinct to make every engagement a foundation for the next one.

  

**Why This Role Matters**

Senior Delivery Managers are where Robots and Pencils' promise of "production-ready AI in 30 to 45 days" actually has to hold. On the engagements you run, you set the pace of delivery, the discipline behind it, and the trust that decides whether the client comes back for more. The work moves only as fast as someone is willing to own the plan, surface trade-offs early, and keep distributed teams pulling in the same direction.

**What** **You'll** **Do**

**Craft & Delivery**

* Lead end-to-end delivery of complex, multi-phase engagements, ensuring alignment across scope, budget, timeline, and quality to meet delivery commitments and achieve successful outcomes

* Facilitate sprint planning, backlog refinement, and delivery execution across one or more cross-functional teams

* Manage phased releases, production readiness, and transitions into operations and maintenance models

* Identify and proactively manage dependencies, risks, scope changes, and escalations before they become blockers

* Define, track, and report delivery KPIs, using data to guide decisions, manage delivery health, and inform tradeoffs across scope, timeline, and budget

* Support QA and UAT efforts, ensuring quality is validated and outcomes meet agreed acceptance criteria

* Bring an AI-forward mindset to your daily work, using tools like Claude to enhance delivery planning, reporting, and stakeholder communications

**Collaboration & Communication**

* Serve as the primary delivery contact for clients, building trusted relationships through transparency, consistency, and clear communication while identifying opportunities to expand value within the engagement

* Lead stakeholder working sessions, roadmap alignment discussions, and delivery forums with confidence

* Communicate progress, risks, and tradeoffs clearly to executive and non-technical audiences

* Partner with Client Partners to spot expansion opportunities inside the engagement (scope, follow-on work, new use cases) and help shape the case for what's next

* Translate delivery progress into business impact for client stakeholders (ROI, milestones, decisions) so executives see ongoing value, not just status

**Leadership & Influence**

* Lead distributed delivery teams across onshore and offshore locations, fostering accountability, collaboration, and delivery excellence

* Coach junior delivery managers with concrete feedback and stretch opportunities, contributing to their development plans

* Foster a culture of transparency, continuous improvement, and high performance across the engagement

* Contribute to improving delivery practices, tools, and frameworks across engagements

* Assess team strengths and gaps on your engagements, and partner with Client Partners to flag staffing needs and high-potential talent for the firm

* Conduct executive interviews for engineers, designers, and other roles joining your engagements, and serve as an essential voice in go/no-go hiring decisions across the firm

  

**What** **You'll** **Bring**

* 5+ years of experience in software delivery, technical project management, or engineering leadership

* Strong understanding of agile delivery practices across complex, multi-team engagements (e.g., Scrum, SAFe, Kanban)

* Experience managing distributed teams across onshore and offshore locations

* Proven ability to deliver complex, multi-platform digital systems in agile environments

* Strong client-facing communication and relationship management skills

* Experience with delivery tooling (e.g., Jira, Confluence, GitHub, Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines)

* Familiarity with cloud-native architectures and AI-enabled platforms

* Demonstrable usage of AI tools to enhance delivery planning, reporting, and documentation (e.g., Claude)

* PMP, Scrum Master, SAFe, or equivalent certification preferred

* Experience in regulated environments (e.g., utilities, government, finance) is a plus

* Instinct for spotting where an engagement can grow, and the credibility with clients to bring those conversations forward with Client Partners

  

**Helpful Extras and Unique Skills**

* Vertical depth in one or more of Consumer Products and Retail, Education, Energy, Financial Services, Healthcare, or Manufacturing

* Experience delivering agentic, AI co-worker, or applied-AI initiatives in enterprise

* Prior career experience in client-facing roles (engagement management, consulting, account leadership) that informs growth conversations

**You'll** **Do Well Here if You Are**

* **A doer.** You see something broken and fix it. You'd rather move on clarity than wait for certainty.

* **A fast learner who knows you don't know everything.** The AI landscape changes weekly. You're senior enough to know better and curious enough to keep learning anyway.

* **Direct in a way that makes the work better.** You give honest feedback. You'd rather have the hard conversation than blow smoke.

* **Obsessed with craft.** You know genius is in the details. You ship exceptional, not perfect, and you don't put your name on work you wouldn't stand behind.

* **Built for ownership.** You honor commitments, admit mistakes fast, and back your teammates when a decision costs something. No handoffs, no finger-pointing.

* **All in.** You treat clients' businesses like your own. You take the work seriously without taking yourself seriously.

* **Resourceful when the budget, timeline, or team is tight.** Constraints don't slow you down. They sharpen you.

* **Calm when it gets hot.** When scope, timeline, and stakeholders pull in three directions, you slow the room down enough to make the right call. You'd rather raise the hard trade-off in week two than absorb it in week eight.

* **Glad to be in the room with people who care as much as you do.** Our teams average fifteen-plus years of experience. We hire people who push each other to do better work.

Title: Manager Technology, Application Support
Description:
**It’s not a package. It’s a promise®.**
As Canada’s leading integrated freight, package, and logistics provider, we’ve been helping promises get where they need to be for more than 60 years. How does the magic happen?

**it’s all possible because of our people.**
So, whether you’re looking to build new skills, make an impact in your community, or inspire your team,

for you.
  
  
**Description**
Purolator relies on a broad portfolio of production applications to support employees, customers, terminals, transportation, and business operations. We are seeking a technology manager to lead the team accountable for application support, reliability, lifecycle management, and enhancements across these services.
  
  
This role will strengthen the operating model for production support by ensuring that projects, support queues, knowledge, monitoring, incidents, vulnerabilities, maintenance, and improvement work are managed with discipline. The successful candidate will combine strong leadership with technical judgement to deliver on new functionality and projects, improve service health, reduce repeat issues, and make support work visible and sustainable.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead, coach, and develop application support employees, contractors, and vendor resources across onshore and offshore locations.
* Own service health and support outcomes for assigned production applications, including availability, performance, security, supportability, and lifecycle risk.
* Establish clear queue ownership, triage standards, priorities, service targets, escalation paths, and workload reporting across incidents, requests, problems, defects, and enhancements.
* Ensure knowledge base articles, runbooks, support procedures, dependency maps, recovery steps, and escalation contacts are accurate, current, usable, and reviewed on a defined cadence.
* Drive strong incident and problem management practices, including major incident leadership, root-cause analysis, corrective actions, trend analysis, and prevention of repeat failures.

Leadership expectations

* Clear ownership from intake through resolution, prevention, and knowledge capture
* Reliable queues, service targets, escalation paths, and stakeholder communications

* Post-secondary diploma or degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

**Experience**

* Progressive experience in application support, production operations, software engineering, SRE, DevOps, or service management, including several years leading technical teams.
* Strong technical understanding of enterprise applications, APIs, integrations, databases, cloud services, deployment pipelines, monitoring, and common failure modes.
* Demonstrated success improving incident, problem, change, knowledge, monitoring, and vulnerability-management practices.
* Experience managing operational queues, support metrics, service targets, backlogs, small enhancements, and technical-debt priorities.
* Ability to use data to identify service trends, explain risk, prioritize investments, and hold teams and vendors accountable.

* Excellent written and verbal communication, with a calm and structured approach during incidents and escalations.
* Experience supporting logistics, transportation, mobile, customer-facing, or 24x7 operational applications.
* Hands-on exposure to AWS, observability platforms, ServiceNow, Jira, GitHub, CI/CD tooling, and automated testing.
* Experience transitioning services from project delivery into stable production ownership.

Title: Head of IT Security
Description:
Job Description:

* Overall security posture of the Group's technology estate, measured against an agreed target maturity (e.g. NIST CSF / ISO 27001 controls)
* Detection and response: 24/7 monitoring coverage, mean time to detect and respond, and effective containment of security incidents
* Vulnerability and patch management: timely remediation of critical and high vulnerabilities across infrastructure and applications
* Identity and access security: privileged access management, MFA coverage and periodic access reviews
* Security by design: security requirements, architecture reviews and testing embedded in digital, cloud and AI projects before go-live
* Regulatory and certification compliance: clean audit outcomes against QCB, NCSA and ISO 27001 / PCI DSS requirements, and timely closure of findings
* Data protection controls (DLP, encryption, email and web security) protecting customer and corporate data
* Security awareness, phishing resilience and a well-structured, capable IT Security team
* Lead the IT Security function under the Group Chief Digital & AI Officer, alongside Head of Group IT and Head of Data & AI
* Owns first-line security controls and operations; works with the Cyber Security & Data Protection Officer (Group Risk) who owns security policy, risk appetite and second-line oversight
* Engages directly with Group IT, Data & AI, digital product teams, business units, Risk, Compliance, Internal Audit, Legal and external vendors
* Operates information security policies, risk and compliance frameworks, and the requirements of QCB, NCSA (National Information Assurance standard), Qatar's personal data protection law and other applicable regulators
* Functions in a fast-changing environment of cloud adoption, digital ecosystem launches and AI deployment, with a 24/7 threat landscape
* Significant autonomy over security architecture, tooling and operations; escalates major incidents, material risks and risk acceptances to the Group Chief Digital & AI Officer and Group Risk
* Prioritizes security investments and remediation across a broad estate with finite budget, people and change windows
* Leads the response to live security incidents under time pressure — containment, forensics, recovery and lessons learned
* Balances strong controls with business agility, enabling digital and AI initiatives without creating unmanaged risk
* Assesses the security of new technologies (cloud services, APIs, third-party platforms, generative AI) and designs proportionate controls
* Interprets regulatory and audit requirements across multiple jurisdictions and translates them into practical technical controls
* Manages third-party and supply-chain security risk across technology vendors and outsourced services
* Translates technical threat and vulnerability data into clear, risk-based messages for executives and committee
* Defines IT security architecture, technical standards and baseline configurations for the Group's technology estate
* Selects security tools and managed-security providers and manages the security budget within delegated authority
* Approves or blocks go-live of systems and changes based on security review outcomes, within the agreed governance framework
* Directs incident response, including containment actions such as isolating systems or disabling compromised accounts
* Sets remediation priorities and deadlines for vulnerabilities and audit findings with Group IT and application owners
* Hires, develops and manages the performance of the IT Security team, in line with HR policies

Educational Qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Information Technology, Engineering or a related field
* Master's degree in Information Security or a related field is preferred
* Professional security certification (CISSP, CISM, CISA, CCSP or equivalent) strongly preferred; vendor certifications (e.g. Fortinet, Microsoft, cloud security) are an advantage

Experience:

* 10+ years of progressive experience in IT, with at least 5 years in information / cyber security
* Minimum 3 years leading an IT security or cybersecurity team, including SOC or security operations
* Proven track record in financial services (insurance, banking, payments or fintech) or another regulated industry
* Hands-on experience with enterprise security technologies: firewalls / NGFW, SIEM, EDR, WAF, DLP,IAM / PAM
* Experience leading ISO 27001 and / or PCI DSS compliance and regulatory or external audits

Title: Manager, AI Platform Observability & Monitoring
Description:
At IMCO, our talent is among the best! IMCO offers a uniquely stimulating and rewarding environment where you can help build and drive organizational transformation, all while seeking to challenge yourself, learn, and grow your career.
  
  
Our culture is built on collaboration and passion, with a shared commitment to delivering lasting value to the clients we serve. Located in downtown Toronto, our vision is to be the partner of choice for Ontario’s public sector funds and to build a high-performing, value-driven asset management firm.
  
  
This job posting is for an existing vacancy. If you are ready to deliver best-in-class service and join a collaborative, motivated and fun team of professionals, IMCO offers the opportunity to do impactful work and broaden your expertise.
  
  
If you’re looking to use your expertise to drive strategic outcomes, we’d love to hear from you.
  
  
‎
  
  
The Manager, AI Platform Observability & Monitoring owns the operational management and health of IMCO’s enterprise AI platforms, with a focus on observability, reliability, performance, usage and cost. The role establishes the monitoring, operational controls and support practices needed to run AI services effectively in production and provides visibility into agent and model behavior, platform performance and emerging operational risks. The role works closely with Architecture, Cybersecurity, AI Governance and technology teams to ensure AI platforms operate within established enterprise standards and guardrails.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**
**AI Platform Operations & Observability**

* Establish and manage enterprise observability and monitoring capabilities across Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Agent 365, Power Platform AI services, and future AI platforms.
* Establish and continuously improve monitoring and observability across AI platforms, models and agents, including performance, reliability, agent activity, usage and operational risks.
* Develop dashboards, alerts and KPIs that provide visibility into platform health, adoption, usage, capacity and cost.
* Identify and coordinate resolution of platform incidents and production issues, maintaining appropriate runbooks, support procedures and service expectations.

**Platform Management & Controls**

* Establish and maintain platform standards covering environments, connectors, capacity, solution management and enterprise use of Copilot Studio and Power Platform.
* Implement and operate platform controls and guardrails aligned with Architecture, Cybersecurity, AI Governance, Privacy and Technology Risk requirements.
* Maintain appropriate access, environment and platform management practices to support secure and scalable use.
* Partner with Architecture, Cybersecurity, Data Governance and AI Governance to ensure the platforms remain aligned with enterprise standards.

**Solution Lifecycle and Operational Readiness**

* Establish lifecycle and operational practices for AI and Power Platform solutions, including development, testing, deployment, release and production support.
* Maintain appropriate ALM, source control and deployment practices, including Azure DevOps integration where applicable.
* Lead operational-readiness assessments for solutions entering production, ensuring monitoring, support, recovery and ownership are in place.
* Manage platform releases, upgrades and changes and support the transition of new solutions into ongoing operations.

**Service Management & Operational Insights**

* Maintain visibility into AI consumption, licensing, platform capacity, costs, reliability and operational effectiveness.
* Provide management reporting and operational insights to support technology, governance and risk decisions.
* Manage operational relationships and service escalations with Microsoft and other relevant platform vendors.
* Evaluate emerging platform-management and observability capabilities that can improve the reliability and operation of IMCO’s AI environment.

**What you need to succeed:**

* 7+ years of experience in enterprise platform operations, cloud services, application operations or digital workplace technologies.
* Strong experience with the Microsoft ecosystem, including Microsoft 365, Azure, Power Platform and enterprise cloud services.
* Hands-on experience with Copilot Studio, Power Platform, enterprise AI platforms, conversational AI or agent-based solutions.
* Demonstrated experience with monitoring, observability, telemetry, incident management and operational reporting for enterprise platforms or applications.
* Experience with Application Lifecycle Management (ALM), DevOps, release management and production support practices.
* Experience establishing and operating platform controls, environment management, support models and operational standards.
* Strong understanding of service health, reliability, capacity, usage and cost management for cloud-based platforms.
* Demonstrated ability to work across Architecture, Cybersecurity, AI Governance, Risk and business teams.
* Strong problem-solving, stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to translate operational data into actionable insights.

**Education & Certifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Information Systems or a related discipline; equivalent relevant experience may also be considered.
* Relevant Microsoft certifications across Power Platform, Azure, Microsoft 365, Copilot Studio or AI are considered assets.

Title: Global Travel Operations & Transformation Manager
Description:
**Who are we?**
Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.
  
  
A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.
  
  
A career at Equinix means being at the center of shaping what comes next and amplifying customer value through innovation and impact. You’ll work across teams, influence key decisions, and help shape the path forward. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.
  
  
**Job Summary**
The Manager, Global Travel Operations & Transformation drives operations and traveler support, ensure consistent service delivery while advancing technology and program transformation. Reporting to the Senior Manager, Global Travel, this role translates program strategy into scalable operational programs, technology enhancements, and measurable outcomes for a global workforce.
  
  
This is a hands-on operational leadership role responsible for managing traveler support, resolving complex issues and escalations, monitoring TMC and supplier performance, and ensuring changes are successfully implemented across the global platform.
  
  
This leader manages day-to-day program performance, advances transformation initiatives, and brings forward emerging capabilities that can improve how employees plan, book, and experience business travel. The ideal candidate is proactive, data-driven, service-oriented, and energized by learning, testing, and embracing new technology, including artificial intelligence and automation. Success requires balancing traveler experience, cost stewardship, policy compliance, duty of care, and operational efficiency while consistently delivering best-in-class service at a global scale.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Global Travel Operations & Service Excellence
  
  

* Manage and continuously improve global travel operations, ensuring reliable, consistent, and traveler-centered service across regions and time zones
* Oversee traveler support, case triage, escalations, service recovery, and issue resolution, with clear accountability and follow-through
* Identify recurring traveler pain points and implement preventive, scalable solutions through knowledge content, process improvements, self-service, and technology
* Monitor program performance, traveler feedback, service levels, and operational trends to proactively address risks and opportunities
* Balance employee experience, cost effectiveness, policy compliance, and duty of care in operational decisions

Program Transformation, Technology & AI
  
  

* Partner with the Senior Manager, Global Travel, to execute the future vision for travel services at Equinix
* Lead transformation initiatives that modernize travel processes, improve the online booking experience, and create simpler, more intuitive traveler journeys
* Identify, evaluate, and help implement emerging technology, artificial intelligence, automation, predictive analytics, and self-service capabilities that improve traveler support and program efficiency
* Build practical use cases for AI and new technology, support responsible adoption, and measure impact on service quality, productivity, and traveler experience
* Stay current on corporate travel trends and digital capabilities, bringing forward recommendations that support continuous program evolution
* Promote a learning mindset by testing new approaches, applying lessons quickly, and helping stakeholders embrace change

Supplier & Service Delivery Management
  
  

* Manage operational relationships with the travel management company and other travel service providers, including performance reviews, escalations, service-level accountability, and continuous improvement
* Use scorecards, service data, traveler feedback, and root-cause analysis to strengthen supplier performance and drive sustainable solutions
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders and external partners on program changes, implementations, testing, and adoption

Data, Insights & Executive Communication
  
  

* Develop and maintain reporting, dashboards, and performance metrics that provide visibility into travel spend, booking behavior, online booking adoption, service performance, policy compliance, and traveler experience
* Translate complex data into concise insights, recommendations, and action plans for leaders and global stakeholders
* Create executive-ready presentations and business reviews that clearly communicate performance, risks, opportunities, decisions, and outcomes
* Improve data quality and reporting discipline to strengthen business decisions and program governance

Global Collaboration & Change Leadership
  
  

* Partner across Corporate Security, Finance, Procurement, HR, Events, Legal, Technology, and regional teams to deliver a cohesive global travel experience
* Translate strategic objectives into clear workplans, operating rhythms, communications, and measurable deliverables
* Lead change management and traveler communications for policy, process, supplier, and technology changes. Influence stakeholders across a matrixed global organization, driving alignment while balancing enterprise standards with local market requirements
* Serve as a thought partner to the Senior Manager, Global Travel by surfacing emerging trends, operational insights, and innovation opportunities

**Qualifications**

* Proven years of progressive experience in corporate travel, travel operations, travel technology, employee services, supplier management, or related field
* Experience managing complex programs or operations across multiple countries or regions
* Demonstrated success leading operational improvements, technology implementations, or transformation initiatives
* Experience managing online booking tools, travel technologies, digital platforms, or service providers
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capability, with experience using data to identify opportunities and drive action
* Excellent program management, organization, prioritization, and issue-resolution skills
* Exceptional written and verbal communication, stakeholder management, and executive presentation skills
* Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, global, and highly matrixed environment
* Experience supporting a large global workforce and delivering services across multiple regions and time zones
* Experience with artificial intelligence, automation, self-service, predictive analytics, or other emerging technology capabilities
* Experience developing dashboards, operational scorecards, and executive reporting
* Knowledge of travel policy governance, duty of care, travel risk management, and global travel industry practices
* Experience managing strategic supplier relationships, performance metrics, and service-level commitments
* Experience with user acceptance testing, requirements gathering, documentation, communications, and change management

Established in the 1930s, Al-Futtaim is one of the most diversified and progressive privately held regional businesses, headquartered in Dubai. **Overview Of The Role:**

The Senior Manager of MIS and Pricing Analytics is responsible for delivering and maintaining management information across Global Aftersales with a focus on reliable, timely reporting that aids decision-making. The role acts as a business product owner for the management reporting portfolio, coordinating with IT and development teams to ensure technical solutions meet business definitions and priorities. The responsibilities include leading product roadmap prioritization, facilitating user acceptance testing, and driving adoption of reporting outputs. The role also governs data quality, access documentation, and service performance, ensuring outputs remain trusted and fit for purpose.

* Own the end-to-end management information and pricing analytics portfolio, ensuring reports and dashboards are delivered accurately, on time, and in alignment with business priorities.

* Prioritize the reporting development roadmap based on commercial value, regulatory needs, and operational urgency.
* Use approved reports to assess price position and convert findings into measurable commercial opportunities.
* Coordinate Information Technology, data engineering, and developers for technical architecture and solution build across Tableau, Alteryx, and Azure.
* Monitor refreshes, availability, data exceptions, and user issues in the reporting portfolio, ensuring incidents are resolved within agreed service levels.
* Define business rules, metric definitions, data ownership, and validation controls to maintain data trust and quality.
* Partner with internal teams to embed standard reports, improve self-service use, and maintain a prioritised improvement backlog.
  

**Required Skills To Be Successful:**

* Strong product ownership and business analysis capability, including stakeholder discovery and process mapping.
* Advanced analytical and financial interpretation skills, particularly in profit and loss drivers.
* Good working knowledge of Tableau, Alteryx and Azure reporting environments.
* Ability to convert complex analysis into concise executive insights and recommendations.
  

**What Qualifies You For The Role:**

* Bachelor degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Data Analytics, Information Systems, or a related discipline.
* 7-10 years of relevant experience in automotive, aftersales, pricing, commercial analytics, management information, or reporting product delivery.
* Demonstrated experience as a business product owner for reporting or analytical products, including business problem definition and roadmap prioritization.
* Strong understanding of revenue, gross margin, pricing, discounts, customer, and product performance.
  

Al-Futtaim Automotive is one of the region's leading mobility businesses, operating across eight countries in the Middle East, Asia and North Africa.

With a portfolio of more than 25 world-leading brands, we deliver one of the region's most comprehensive mobility ecosystems.

Our capabilities span passenger vehicles, commercial vehicles and industrial equipment, backed by integrated logistics, leasing, aftersales and financial services that deliver a seamless customer experience across every stage of the mobility journey.

Our vision is to become a world-class mobility player, creating better experiences for our customers through innovation, digital transformation and a relentless focus on customer experience. We work alongside some of the world's most trusted automotive brands to shape the future of mobility, delivering solutions that meet the evolving needs of individuals, businesses and communities.

Behind everything we do is a team of more than 9,000 colleagues united by ambition, collaboration and a shared commitment to progress. Together, we're shaping the future of mobility, embracing new technologies and creating better experiences for our customers. At Al-Futtaim Automotive, you'll be empowered to turn ambition into action and help move our customers, our business and your career forward.
