Title: Product Manager I
Description:
Take a step forward and let Edenred surprise you.

Every day, we deliver innovative solutions to improve the life of millions of people, connecting employees, companies, and merchants all around the world.

We know there are hundred ways for you to grow. With us, you will expand your skills in a multicultural, challenging, and dynamic environment.

**Dare to join Edenred and get ready to thrive in a global company that will offer you endless opportunities.**

Edenred is all about meritocracy. You come as you are, and you contribute. Indeed, the Edenred Group recognizes, recruits and develops all talents and singularities.

We are committed to preventing all forms of discrimination and to providing all our candidates with equal opportunities regardless of their gender and gender expression, disability, origin, religious belief and sexual orientation or any other criteria.

**About Edenred**

Edenred is the leading digital platform for corporate services in the areas of benefits, professional mobility, and B2B payments.

Operating in 44 countries, it connects more than 60 million users to over 2 million partner merchants through more than 1 million client companies.

Edenred offers solutions dedicated to employee engagement (meal vouchers, commuting, gift vouchers, wellness, rewards, and preferential offers to boost purchasing power), mobility (multi-energy solutions, including EV charging, fleet management services, maintenance, toll, and parking), and corporate payments (virtual cards). In addition to its own solutions, Edenred also distributes offers from more than 120 partners on its platform.

True to the Group's purpose, “Enrich connections. For good.”, these solutions enhance users' well-being and purchasing power and simplify the lives of professional drivers while promoting access to healthier food, more environmentally friendly products, and more sustainable mobility. They improve the attractiveness and efficiency of businesses and vitalize the employment market and the local economy.

Edenred's 12,000 employees are committed to making the world of work a connected ecosystem that is safer, more efficient and more responsible every day.

In 2024, thanks to its global technology assets, the Group generated a business volume of nearly €45 billion, mainly through mobile applications, online platforms and cards.

Edenred is listed on the Euronext Paris stock exchange and included in the following indices: CAC Next 20, CAC Large 60, Euronext 100, Euronext Tech Leaders, FTSE4Good, DJSI Europe Index, DJSI World Index, and MSCI Europe.

  

**The UAE CONTEXT**

Edenred UAE is a fast-growing payroll service provider serving more than 20,000 businesses and more than 2.2 million unbanked employees. We service over 10 banks and 35 financial institutions.

We offer a unique value proposition for companies to manage their payroll, and for employees to receive their salaries and use them in the simplest way — through multiple value-added services in our mobile app (money transfer, mobile recharge, card services and more).

  

**THE ROLE**

Most of our users receive their salary on a card we issue, send money home through our app, and pay for their week with a product our team built. For a large share of them, we are their first and only financial relationship. That raises the stakes on every decision — and makes this one of the more interesting product jobs in the region.

You will own product strategy and delivery for a product area inside an organisation that has the autonomy of a startup and the reach of a multinational. You set direction for your area, shape its strategy, and make day-to-day calls that are demonstrably aligned to a clear product vision — with the coaching and air cover to get it right.

Depending on where the business needs you most, you might begin in financial crime and compliance — making onboarding fast without weakening controls, catching fraud earlier, turning regulatory requirements into changes engineering can actually build. Or you might begin on the consumer side — remittance, cards, wallet, lending — working acquisition, activation, retention and monetisation problems for 2.2 million people.

The PMs who do best here are the ones who can hold a regulatory constraint and a growth funnel in their head at the same time.

  

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Own a product area. Identify the levers and problems that matter, build a now / next / later roadmap you can defend against real resource constraints, and treat company resources as your own.

* Set and evangelise a vision. Make sure your decisions and your squad's decisions stay aligned to it, and that everyone can explain the “why” without you in the room.

* Lead discovery. Decide independently what to ask and who to ask, know when research is and isn't needed, and turn what you learn into decisions rather than decks.

* De-risk deliberately. Define the riskiest assumptions behind an initiative, prioritise them, and pick the right test for each — balancing speed against certainty instead of defaulting to trial and error.

* Use data properly. Judge which metrics matter, read experiment results honestly, and make confident scale-or-pivot calls. You self-serve across Excel, CleverTap and SQL.

* Ship with engineering. Write crisp PRDs, mitigate feasibility risk early, hold the bar on specifications, and clear blockers before they bite.

* Drive outcomes, not output. Take initiatives, objectives and key results to completion on time, and be honest about what moved and what didn't.

* Work the room. Frame ambiguous problems, facilitate strong problem-solving discussions, manage stakeholder expectations, and pull in senior leaders when that's what unblocks the outcome.

* Communicate top-down. Present a cohesive narrative to data, design, engineering and senior business audiences, and make the trade-offs legible.

Stay close to a unique customer. Our users are underbanked, often first-time app users, sending money to families across several corridors. Every decision comes back to what they're trying to achieve.  

  

**YOUR PROFILE**

* 3+ years in product management - with a track record of independently owning a product or product area and shipping.

* Evidence you moved the numbers - KPIs and OKRs that mattered, not just features that launched.

* Range - Comfort operating in a regulated environment and appetite for consumer growth problems. Experience in payments, fintech, fraud, compliance or high-scale consumer products is a plus, not a requirement.

* Strong analytical instincts - You can set sensible thresholds, spot risk in data, size an opportunity, and check whether something is actually working.

* Technical fluency - Enough to discuss APIs, automation and trade-offs with engineers and be taken seriously.

* Excellent organisation, judgment and attention to detail - you can operate without direction.

* Communication and influence - You drive consensus, articulate recommendations and trade-offs to senior executives, and write specs engineers can build from without guessing.

Beyond the craft, we care a lot about how you work:

* Ownership — you take responsibility for outcomes, speak up when something looks wrong, and follow through on what you commit to.

* Collaboration — you listen actively, build trust across teams, and bring people along rather than pushing work over the wall.

* Problem solving — creative and structured, using both data and judgment to land on an answer.

* Drive — proactive and entrepreneurial; you clear your own obstacles and ask for help early when you're stuck.

* Curiosity — genuinely interested in users, and in how the product works under the hood.

Senior candidates will also be expected to coach and mentor junior product managers, review their work, and contribute to hiring.

  

**REPORTING STRUCTURE**

Reporting to: Product Lead / Senior Product Manager, depending on the area you join.

Working with: Engineering, Design, Data, Compliance, Financial Crime, Marketing, Operations, Customer Support, and product managers across the business.

  

**WHY THIS ROLE**

You will not be the eleventh PM on a mature product in a crowded market. You will own high-visibility initiatives end-to-end, from problem definition to measurable business outcome, on a platform that has a direct, visible effect on the financial lives of millions of people.

If that sounds like your kind of problem, apply.

  

*Edenred UAE is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of nationality, gender, age, religion or background.*

  
  

**Apply now and Vibe with Us!**

Title: Digital Operations Lead - YuCOS
Description:
**YuCOS Digital Operations Lead**

The Digital Operations Lead owns the rollout of YuCos, our collections technology platform, across the call centre, and runs the digital channels (starting with email campaigns) that sit on top of it.

**Role purpose**

YuCos is the platform our collections teams work in every day. This role makes sure it is implemented properly inside the call centre, adopted by agents and team leaders, and used to run digital outreach such as email campaigns, sms, conversational bots, and IVR. You are the single owner linking collections operations, technology and digital communication.

* **Function:**
  Collections Operations / Digital Operations
* **Location:**
  Karama, Dubai, UAE.

**Key responsibilities**

**YuCos implementation in the call centre**

* Lead end-to-end rollout of YuCos across call centre teams: requirements, configuration, testing, go-live and stabilisation.
* Translate collections processes (allocation, dialling, follow-up, promise-to-pay, escalation) into YuCos workflows and rules.
* Coordinate with the technology, product and vendor teams on configuration, integrations, releases and defect resolution.
* Run user acceptance testing, training and floor support; build user guides and SOPs.
* Drive adoption: monitor usage, remove friction, and gather feedback from agents and team leaders for the product roadmap.

**Digital operations and email campaigns**

* Plan, build, schedule and run email campaigns for collections: reminders, promise-to-pay follow-ups, settlement offers and payment confirmations.
* Manage audience segmentation, templates, sending cadence and suppression and opt-out lists.
* Test and optimize campaigns (subject lines, timing, content) using open, click, contact and payment-conversion data.
* Coordinate with call centre teams so digital and voice outreach support each other and do not duplicate contact.
* Extend digital operations to other channels (SMS, WhatsApp, payment links) as the business requires.

**Governance, reporting and compliance**

* Ensure campaigns and platform use follow regulatory, data-protection and collections-conduct requirements.
* Own reporting on campaign performance, platform usage and operational KPIs; present insights to management.
* Maintain change control, access management and documentation for YuCos in operations.

**Requirements**

**Essential**

* Bachelor's degree in business, technology, operations or a related field.
* 5+ years in call centre, collections or contact-centre operations, with at least 2 years leading system implementations or digital projects.
* Hands-on experience with collections or CRM platforms, and with email campaign tools (segmentation, templates, deliverability, analytics).
* Strong process-mapping and requirements skills; able to turn operational needs into clear system specifications.
* Comfortable with data: reporting, dashboards, and A/B testing; advanced Excel, with SQL or BI tools a plus.
* Strong stakeholder management across operations, technology, compliance and vendors.
* Clear communicator and trainer who can coach frontline teams through change.

**Preferred**

* Experience in lending, banking or financial-services collections.
* Knowledge of data-protection and collections-conduct regulations in the region.
* Exposure to SMS, WhatsApp or omnichannel communication tools.
* Project management certification (PMP, PRINCE2 or Agile).
* Strong English language skills. Knowledge of Arabic would be an added advantage.

Title: Senior Manager - QA & Site Co-ordination - AA9
Description:
Lead the independent quality assurance and site co-ordination function for City Ops ICT assets throughout the project lifecycle. Establish and operate consistent quality controls, stage-gate checkpoints, inspection and testing arrangements, and evidence-based validation of operational requirements before handover and service transition. Maintain objective oversight of gaps, defects and remediation, while keeping delivery accountability with the relevant project, contractor, vendor or asset owner. Set the strategic QA direction, lead the assurance team and provide senior management with independent recommendations on quality, readiness and residual risk.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Independent, evidence-based judgement and challenge of incomplete readiness evidence
* Senior leadership of QA/QC governance, quality strategy, risk prioritisation and structured issue escalation
* Clear stakeholder communication, cross-vendor co-ordination and executive, audit-ready reporting
* Ability to direct field verification teams and manage site access, safety and inspection logistics
* Portfolio-level prioritisation, resource planning, supplier performance oversight and continuous improvement
* QA Governance & Independence
* Own and maintain the City Ops ICT QA/QC and gap-assessment framework, including standards, workflows, evidence requirements, severity classification, validation, prioritisation, closure and reporting.
* Define QA checkpoints, sign-off criteria, Site Inspection Plans, asset-specific checklists, test scripts, hold / witness points and acceptance evidence standards.
* Provide independent assessment of operational readiness and quality, separate from project delivery accountability; challenge incomplete or disputed evidence and escalate material acceptance risks.
* Lead the QA team, including field / testing and domain verification resources, and apply consistent methods across sites and packages.
* Set portfolio QA priorities, allocate assurance resources and provide senior leadership with independent recommendations on systemic quality risks and readiness.

* Site Co-ordination, Inspection & Testing
* Plan and co-ordinate site access, inspections, permits, inductions, vendor attendance, equipment and documentation for site verification activities.
* Direct and quality-assure document reviews, physical inspections, interviews and functional testing performed by Field and Test Engineers.
* Co-ordinate physical and functional verification of ICT infrastructure and systems, including cabling / fibre, switches, equipment rooms, CCTV / VMS, access control, UPS and associated power arrangements.
* Ensure inspection records contain checklists, photos, test results, calibration and safety evidence, with a clear pass, gap or not-applicable outcome.
* Operational Readiness & Handover Assurance
* Translate approved service, support, monitoring, resilience, cybersecurity, lifecycle and non-functional requirements into measurable acceptance criteria.
* Validate readiness evidence, test and commissioning results, as-built and configuration records, asset information, licences, warranties, training, O&M documentation and support arrangements.
* Provide an evidence-based recommendation on handover readiness, documenting exceptions, residual risks, conditional acceptance and corrective actions; do not replace the authorised acceptance decision-maker.
* Confirm outstanding defects, vendor obligations and support information are transferred into the appropriate QTech ITSM / ServiceNow and operational governance processes.
* Issue Management, Reporting & Escalation
* Own and maintain the Master Gap Register, Defect / Snag Register and Remediation Tracker as controlled, traceable records.
* Validate findings for evidence sufficiency, severity, ownership and corrective action; track target dates and verify objective closure evidence.
* Escalate critical / high findings, disputed classifications, safety concerns and unresolved readiness risks through agreed governance channels.
* Prepare dashboards, executive summaries and decision-ready reporting on quality status, ageing, dependencies, closure trends and handover risks; lead root-cause reviews and continuous improvement.
* Stakeholder & Team Co-ordination
* Co-ordinate inspections, validation workshops and readiness reviews with City Ops ICT, QTech, MDU / EBU, Districts, Cybersecurity, vendors, contractors and service integrators.
* Provide leadership, work direction and coaching to field / test engineers and support consistent technical and audit-ready quality records.
* Hold delivery partners accountable for evidence quality and remediation commitments while preserving independent assurance boundaries.
* Seven Stage-Gate Quality Checkpoints
* CP1 - Understand Project Scope: Confirm asset / system scope, site constraints, applicable standards, stakeholders and QA approach.
* CP2 - Define City ICT Operations Requirements: Translate operational, service and non-functional requirements into measurable acceptance criteria.
* CP3 - Review Procurement Packages: Review RFPs, BoQs and specifications for inspection, testing, handover, support and evidence provisions.
* CP4 - Review Material Submissions: Review technical / material submissions, methods and test plans; flag deviations and lifecycle impacts.
* CP5 - Verify Delivered Requirements: Witness inspections and tests, validate as-built / configuration evidence and track defects to closure.
* CP6 - Support Handover Acceptance: Review handover packs and readiness evidence; recommend acceptance, exceptions and corrective actions.
* CP7 - Service Management Transition: Confirm quality records, support procedures and open obligations are transferred into operational governance.

  
  
**Requirements**

**Minimum Qualifications**

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Science, Telecommunications, Electronics or a related discipline.

**Professional Certifications**

Preferred: PMP / PRINCE2, ITIL Foundation and ISO 9001 auditor or equivalent QA qualification; advantageous: Lean Six Sigma and relevant technical / testing certifications.

**Skills**

* ICT QA/QC governance, inspection / test planning, stage-gate assurance and evidence-based acceptance.
* Practical understanding of ICT infrastructure, smart-city and physical-security systems, commissioning, operational readiness and service transition.
* Defect and gap classification, root-cause analysis, remediation tracking, registers, dashboards and audit-ready reporting.
* Site safety, permit-to-work, field inspection co-ordination, cross-vendor dependencies and stakeholder management.
* Independent judgement, clear escalation, strong written reporting and the ability to challenge incomplete evidence constructively.
* Experience leading gap / defect registers, site inspection programmes, acceptance criteria and management reporting.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, IT, Computer Science, Telecommunications, Electronics or related discipline.
* Preferred: PMP / PRINCE2, ITIL Foundation and ISO 9001 auditor or equivalent QA qualification; advantageous: Lean Six Sigma and relevant technical / testing certifications.

Founded in 1987, Stefanini helps midsize, large and global enterprises increase the efficiency of their IT operations while leveraging technology to empower their businesses. Our offerings include IT Infrastructure Outsourcing, End-User Computing, Application Managed Services, and Mainframe Modernization, with solutions spanning automation, cloud, IoT, UX, and AI alongside service desk, field service, and BPO. We have over 30,000 employees across 77 offices in 41 countries.

This on-site Technical Service Manager role leads Modern Endpoint and Digital Workplace services for a key strategic client, combined with oversight of the Field Services teams and vendors that support the client's operations across multiple regions. You will be the single point of contact and technical service owner for endpoint management (SCCM/MECM, Microsoft Intune, JAMF), M365 collaboration, Confluence, Citrix virtual workplace, and vulnerability management, ensuring operational readiness, security compliance, and an excellent end-user experience. In this blended role, you will connect technical service ownership with hands-on Field Services delivery, so that endpoint, collaboration, and security outcomes are carried out on the ground through on-site deskside support, hardware lifecycle, and site services. Working closely with client stakeholders, the Business Unit Leader, and the Client Success Director, you will drive program strategy, ensure operational readiness, own governance and service quality, and lead continuous improvement and innovation. This position requires strong attention to detail, technical breadth across the digital workplace, and excellent interpersonal skills.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities****
**Modern Endpoint & Digital Workplace Services**

* Serve as technical service owner for Modern Endpoint services across Windows, macOS, and mobile devices
* Oversee endpoint management platforms: SCCM/MECM, Microsoft Intune (including Autopilot and co-management), and JAMF for Apple devices
* Govern OS deployment, application packaging and distribution, patching, configuration baselines, and device compliance
* Oversee M365 collaboration services (Teams, Exchange Online, SharePoint, OneDrive) and Confluence/Atlassian collaboration platforms
* Manage Citrix Virtual Workplace (Virtual Apps and Desktops/VDI) service health, capacity, and user experience
* Own vulnerability management for the endpoint estate: drive remediation, patch SLAs, and compliance reporting with Security teams (e.g., Tenable, Qualys, CrowdStrike, Defender)

+ Own endpoint support, provisioning, refresh, mobility, collaboration, conferencing, printing, and workplace technology services across corporate and field environments.

+ Establish and enforce cycle-count standards, investigate variances, and drive timely reconciliation and corrective action.

+ Manage assigned Incident, Request, Problem, Knowledge, Service Level, and Continual Improvement practices.
+ Apply ITIL foundations and relevant industry practices to improve service consistency, accountability, and outcomes without unnecessary administrative burden.
+ Use operational data, customer feedback, root-cause analysis, and lessons learned to set priorities and measure results.
+ Maintain a service improvement roadmap tied to business priorities, operational risk, and measurable outcomes.
+ Drive automation, self-service, AI-assisted support, remote support, workflow optimization, and knowledge management where they improve service, speed, or cost.

+ Build and develop high-performing Service Desk and Field Services teams across a distributed operating footprint.
+ Set clear priorities, decision rights, performance expectations, and escalation responsibilities.
+ Strengthen capability through workforce planning, succession, cross-training, field exposure, and knowledge transfer.
+ Make timely decisions that balance safety, operational impact, cybersecurity, user experience, cost, and long-term supportability.
+ Anticipate material risks, challenge assumptions, and present clear recommendations to Technology and Operations leadership.

+ Contribute to operating and capital planning for support operations, end-user technology, tools, lifecycle programs, vendors, and managed services.
+ Develop investment recommendations tied to operational continuity, productivity, risk reduction, scale, service improvement, or cost avoidance.
+ Support vendor selection, contract and renewal reviews, service-performance management, and commercial evaluations.
+ Maintain support technology roadmaps, standards, lifecycle plans, priorities, risks, and performance outcomes.
+ Maintain asset, licensing, audit, security, and records controls across assigned services.

* Stakeholder Partnership & Communication

+ Represent corporate and field support requirements in strategy, standards, projects, and investment decisions.
+ Communicate service health, incidents, risks, priorities, investments, and results to business, field, technical, and executive leaders.
+ Maintain direct engagement with corporate business leaders, operational leaders, and service partners to validate performance and identify emerging needs.

* Other duties as assigned.

**MINIMUM ESSENTIAL QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 10+ years of progressive IT operations, enterprise support, field services, end-user support, or service delivery experience, including 5+ years leading distributed teams.
* Proven leadership of Service Desk, corporate support, and Field Services in a complex, multi-site environment; industrial or energy experience is strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated success managing ownership, dependencies, changes, and incidents across Corporate IT, Field Operations, and OT.
* Ability to set strategy, execute at scale, lead change, and deliver measurable operating results.

* Execution: Converts strategy into operating plans, clear measures, and sustained results.
* Business Judgment: Balances business needs, operational risk, cybersecurity, service, cost, and long-term supportability.
* Executive Communication: Frames issues, options, decisions, and results with clarity and credibility.
* Participate in a leadership escalation rotation for major incidents and critical technology events; this role is not the routine first-line on-call resource.
* Travel up to 25% to corporate offices, field locations, terminals, plants, operational facilities, and vendor sites.
* Comply with applicable site access, safety, personal protective equipment, and operational requirements when visiting field facilities.
* Ability to occasionally lift and move technology equipment weighing up to 50 pounds.

* Experience with enterprise ITSM, endpoint and mobile management, remote support, collaboration, asset management, and automation platforms.
* Experience supporting remote locations with limited connectivity, constrained local resources, or 24x7 operations.
* Experience supporting midstream, pipeline, terminal, plant, gathering and processing, or comparable field operations.

Title: Middle East Tech Business Manager
Description:
**About the role**
------------------

Founded by Gabrielle Chanel in 1910, CHANEL is a French luxury house renowned for its timeless elegance and innovation across Fashion, Fragrance & Beauty, and Watches & Fine Jewelry.

The Europe Region brings together several markets to distribute CHANEL’s creations and deliver the ultimate luxury experience to our clients.

Headquartered in Dubai, the Middle East Market covers nine countries: United Arab Emirates, Qatar, Lebanon, Saudi Arabia, Oman, Bahrain, Kuwait, Egypt and Jordan.

We are looking for a Middle East Tech Business Manager to support both the operational excellence and continued technology transformation of the Market.

Reporting to the Head of Digital and Tech, the Middle East Tech Business Manager acts as **a Tech business partner for the Middle East Market, connecting local business priorities with the Europe Tech Roadmap.**

The role is responsible for ensuring the reliable, secure and effective delivery of IT infrastructure and technology services across the Market's business environments, including boutiques, wholesale operations, the distribution center and headquarters.

These services include end-user equipment, connectivity, servers, retail systems, meeting rooms, video-conferencing solutions and digital workplace technologies.

The Tech Business Manager leads a team of four people, one internal employee and three external resources. He/she is responsible for organizing, developing and evolving the team and its capabilities in line with changing business and technology needs, while managing the Tech budget, procurement activities, vendors and partners and ensuring a high level of service and delivery.

**What impact you can create at CHANEL**
----------------------------------------

Beyond operational excellence, the Tech Business Manager partners closely with Retail, business functions and Digital & Data teams to enable technology-driven transformation across the Market. The role contributes to Retail and business projects, identifies opportunities where technology can address business challenges, and supports the deployment and adoption of new technologies, including emerging AI capabilities.

As an ambassador for the Tech department, the Tech Business Manager ensures that the house technology strategies and standards are translated into relevant and effective solutions for the Middle East, while bringing local business needs and opportunities back into Europe Tech roadmaps.

**As an ambassador for the Tech department, act as a trusted Tech partner to the Middle East business, developing a strong understanding of business and Retail priorities, challenges and opportunities.**

Maintain close proximity to the business and Retail teams by regularly visiting boutiques and other sites, understanding user journeys and technology-related pain points, and proactively identifying opportunities for improvement.

Monitor user satisfaction with Tech services provided, identify areas for improvement and recommend appropriate actions.

Translate local business needs into clear technology requirements and use cases, **connecting the relevant local and Europe teams and contributing to the evolution of technology roadmaps.**

Proactively identify opportunities to simplify, automate and improve Tech services, enhancing both operational efficiency and employee experience. Ensure appropriate business continuity and resilience of critical Market technology services.

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Operational Excellence / Run**

Enable local teams to work effectively by providing reliable devices, including tills, printers, laptops and mobile phones, infrastructure including network equipment and servers, and standard applications across boutiques, offices and other physical locations.

Ensure contractors and partners deliver high-quality Tech support and meet agreed Service Level Agreements.

Secure and continuously optimize Tech infrastructure and support operations across boutiques and wholesale businesses for all CHANEL divisions, Fashion, Fragrance & Beauty and Watches & Fine Jewelry, as well as Corporate functions including HR and Finance.

### **Accompany the Tech Transformation**

Contribute and maintain the Middle East Tech roadmap and project portfolio, including budget, and demands prioritization with Europe Region and Middle East business teams.

Oversee the local implementation of Tech applications and services within the Market, ensuring local requirements are understood and addressed.

Partner with Retail and business teams on technology-enabled transformation initiatives, helping translate business needs into technology solutions and ensuring their technical feasibility, integration and successful implementation.

Contribute to the exploration and implementation of new technologies that can enhance client, employee and business experiences, working closely with Digital, Data and Europe Tech teams.

Contribute to real-estate projects, primarily boutique openings and renovations, as well as office and logistics projects. Oversee the implementation of technology components, including hardware and software installation and validation, and manage suppliers and subcontractors in close coordination with Regional and Global teams.

### **AI & Emerging Technologies**

Act as the local Tech partner for AI and emerging technology adoption, working closely with Digital, Data, business teams and Europe Tech.

Contribute to AI acculturation across the Market by helping teams understand available capabilities, opportunities, boundaries and responsible usage.

Partner with Business & Digital teams to identify and assess relevant AI and technology use cases, supporting experimentation and a test-and-learn approach.

Support the technical assessment and implementation of prioritized use cases, ensuring appropriate integration, security, architecture and compliance.

**Connect local opportunities and learnings with Europe Tech teams.**

### **Cybersecurity & Compliance**

Implement cybersecurity guidelines in coordination with Global and Regional Cybersecurity teams and support initiatives to strengthen cybersecurity awareness among end users.

Ensure Global data protection and technology compliance requirements are appropriately implemented within the Market, working with the relevant teams and addressing local requirements where applicable.

Title: Lead System Administrator
Location: Dubai, DU, United Arab Emirates | Dubai, Dubai, United Arab Emirates
Description:
**About Us**

UMO is a stealth-mode FinTech venture aiming to evolve the way people experience money by building a unified, AI-powered, yet deeply human money platform across fiat, crypto, and investments – subject to regulatory approvals. The platform is being designed to break down traditional barriers to money across access, assets, and experience, enabling simpler, more adaptive ways for people to interact with financial services.

We are currently developing our MVP and navigating licensing requirements, with a multidisciplinary team of 100+ people representing 20+ nationalities. With our headquarters in the UAE, we are united behind a shared ambition and a relentless focus on serving our customers.

**About this role**

  

You will own internal IT end to end — identity and access, SaaS services, workstations and the corporate network that every colleague relies on daily. You'll lead a team of five administrators and take charge of the subscription budget, quarterly planning and renewals. We give you real decision-making authority: only spend above the limit, headcount or key vendor changes, risk acceptance and company-wide changes go up for approval. Everything else is your call, within the boundaries set out under "Decision Rights".

**You'll take ownership of:**

This is a hands-on lead role. Roughly 30% of your time goes to people, planning and alignment, and 70% to hands-on work: complex changes, incident investigation, configuration reviews, automation. You set up routine work so that it runs without you.

**1. Team and quarterly planning**

* Lead five administrators: 1:1s, goals, feedback. Run hiring for approved positions and, when necessary, parting ways — the latter agreed with your manager.
* Organize work across time zones: open incidents are handed over in writing to a specific person, and inconvenient hours are shared fairly. Three time zones cover about 13 hours of the working day, but not 24/7: you decide what truly requires a night-time or weekend response.
* Every critical system has a primary administrator and a backup who knows how to restore it.
* Each quarter, bring a plan: goals, owners, a support buffer and a list of what did not make the cut. Base it on feedback from engineers, recurring incidents and the renewal calendar. At the end of the quarter, show what was done, what was not and why. If urgent work comes up mid-quarter, say what moves and at what cost.
* Prepare a monthly report for the area: service and support health, access status, subscription spend and optimization results, key risks and items that need a management decision.

**2. Identity and access reviews**

* The identity provider is the central point of access provisioning: SSO, phishing-resistant MFA, role-based groups, SCIM. Hiring, transfers and terminations are triggered from the HR system.
* You verify revocation in the application itself. Deactivating a user in the identity provider does not end active sessions or revoke API tokens, local accounts and guest access. Systems without SCIM have an owner for manual revocation, and you make sure it is done.
* Access review frequency depends on risk: privileged and financial systems quarterly, everything else every six months. The system owner decides on each access, revocation is confirmed in the target system, and every exception has a reason and an expiry date. Results are retained as audit evidence.

**3. Corporate services and developer support**

* **Zero Trust access and DNS:** Zero Trust for internal tools (access policies, secure web gateway, device posture) and DNS for corporate domains. Policy changes roll out to a limited group first, and the on-call engineer has a rollback procedure. WAF and the product perimeter stay with DevOps.
* **Cloud, corporate side:** Cloud SSO integrated with the identity provider, role assignments agreed with DevOps, sandbox accounts, spend in corporate accounts. Organization structure and production belong to DevOps.
* **Corporate messaging:** Apps and integrations, guests and external channels, retention policies. Before a bot is installed, you know what data it reads and who owns it.
* **Collaboration suite:** Mail, calendar and documents: sharing rules, third-party OAuth apps, SPF, DKIM and DMARC, data transfer at offboarding.
* **Ticketing and knowledge base:** Permissions, projects and spaces, SSO sign-in. The ticketing system is the team's work queue, the knowledge base holds documentation.
* **Workstations:** MDM: encryption, updates, security policies, shipping a laptop to another country with zero-touch setup.
* Build self-service for developers: standard access is requested via chat or a ticket, approved by the resource owner and granted automatically for a limited time.
* Set support priorities: major outages and security incidents first, then requests that block teams from working.
* Together with DevOps, define clear ownership boundaries and drive shared requests to resolution: a ticket is closed when the problem is solved for the user, not when it has been handed to another team.

**4. Subscriptions and costs**

* Maintain the SaaS registry: owner, cost, number of seats, actual usage, renewal date and the last day the order can still be changed.
* Review paid seats separately from access reviews. Once a month, reconcile paid seats against activity. Long inactivity is a reason to check with the owner, not to reclaim the seat automatically: there are break-glass accounts and tools that are only needed once a quarter.
* Plan each contract review backwards from the last day the order can be changed or the renewal cancelled. By that day, the volume is agreed, the negotiation position is ready and the vendor has been notified if required. Example: 80 editor seats are paid for, 30 are actively used — we go to the vendor with 35 and a question about the pricing tier.
* Find shadow IT through OAuth grants and corporate card spend. In corporate cloud accounts, analyze bill growth by account and service together with the resource owner. Measure savings against invoices, separating realized savings from those expected at the next renewal.

**5. AI and automation**

For you, AI is the normal way the whole team works. What we expect:

* First-line support in chat: answers from the knowledge base with source links, request classification and ticket creation, handing unclear cases to a human.
* Preparation of access reviews and license reviews: AI reconciles exports from the identity provider, the HR system and applications and produces a list of anomalies for an administrator to verify.
* Measure the impact: compare time before and after rollout, including the time spent reviewing and correcting errors.
* Set the rules: what data may be shared with a model and where only a human makes the decision. AI does not grant privileged access or reset MFA: an administrator does that, verifying the employee's identity before any MFA reset.
* The whole team knows how to use these tools, not just you.
  

**About you:**

  

* **Leadership:** 2+ years of directly managing system administrators or IT engineers, including a distributed team. You have hired, given difficult feedback and changed priorities mid-quarter in a way the team understood.
* **Okta, in depth:** SSO, SCIM, lifecycle management, MFA policies, Workflows. You have implemented it or significantly restructured it, not just created users.
* **Cloudflare, AWS, Slack, at a working level:** Cloudflare Zero Trust and DNS; AWS IAM, IAM Identity Center, billing and Cost Explorer; Slack administration: apps, guests, Slack Connect. For each, you can walk us through a change you made yourself: how you tested it and what you did when something broke. Kubernetes, CI/CD and product networking are not required.
* **Google Workspace, Atlassian Cloud, Kandji:** Administration of Google Workspace (sharing, OAuth apps, SPF, DKIM, DMARC) and Atlassian Cloud (Jira, Confluence: permissions, projects, Okta sign-in). Kandji or another MDM for macOS.
* **AI, advanced level:** You have built an LLM-based automation that your colleagues actually used. In the interview, you will show what was built, how you evaluated errors, where you kept a human in the loop and how much time it saves. "I write prompts in ChatGPT" is not what this role needs.
* **Scripting and APIs:** Confident in Python or similar, and able to review other people's code.
* **Access and audit:** You have taken access reviews through to actual revocation and answered auditors' questions.
* **Money:** You have managed SaaS renewals and can name the amount you saved and explain where it came from.
* **Communication:** Fluent English for vendors, documentation and the team.
  

**Can get you a few bonus points**

  

* Fintech or another regulated industry; PCI DSS, SOC 2, ISO 27001.
* Terraform for Okta, Cloudflare and AWS.
* Okta Identity Governance or similar, SaaS management platforms.
  

**The UMO Standard**

* **Dynamic Work Environment:** Vibrant offices and strong local teams across Lisbon, Dubai, Kyiv, and Lviv — with openness to remote for the right fit.
* **Rest & Recovery:** 24 days of annual leave, dedicated paid sick leave, and observance of Public Holidays to keep you at your best.
* **Recharge Week:** After your first year with us, enjoy two consecutive 4-day work weeks annually — a built-in reset to help you sustain peak performance for the long run.
* **Full Setup:** Top-of-the-line hardware and a home office stipend so you can do your best work anywhere.
* **Growth Ecosystem:** A dedicated learning budget and room to grow as the company grows.
* **Impact & Ownership:** Your work directly shapes the product and company direction — not just executes it.

IGM Financial Inc. is a leading wealth and asset management company in Canada, managing approximately $310 billion in assets as of December 31, 2025. It offers financial planning and investment services to over two million Canadians through IG Wealth Management and Mackenzie Investments.

Our Values: Be better; we strive for improvement in everything we do. Be accountable; we foster clarity and are empowered to act responsibly. Be a team; we are united to drive collective impact to achieve our goals.

**Role Overview**
  
The Manager, IT Audit reports to the Director, IT Audit and is responsible for planning and executing risk-based technology audit and advisory engagements. This role focuses on assessing risks and controls across cloud environments, DevSecOps practices, cybersecurity, artificial intelligence (AI) solutions, and enterprise technology platforms. The successful candidate will work closely with technology and business stakeholders to provide practical, risk-based recommendations that strengthen governance, risk management, and control processes.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Leverage AI and analytics tools to improve audit efficiency, risk assessment, testing methodologies, and reporting processes.
* Assess governance and controls over AI and machine learning solutions, including model development, validation, monitoring, explainability, accountability, bias management, and data governance.
* Develop and execute data-enabled audit approaches using analytics, visualization, automation, and continuous auditing techniques.
* Assess risks associated with generative AI technologies, large language models, agentic systems, and third-party AI services.
* Lead and execute technology audit engagements from planning through reporting.
* Perform audits of cloud environments, including governance, security, identity and access management, resilience, and third-party risk controls.
* Assess DevSecOps processes, CI/CD pipelines, secure software development practices, and deployment controls.
* Evaluate governance, risk management, security, privacy, and regulatory considerations associated with AI solutions and emerging technologies.
* Assess IT general controls, automated controls, application controls, and cybersecurity controls.
* Participate in audits of major technology transformation initiatives, cloud migrations, and digital programs.
* Support integrated audits by identifying technology risks that may impact business processes.
* Develop clear and concise audit findings and recommendations.
* Build effective relationships with technology, cybersecurity, risk management, and business stakeholders.
* Monitor emerging risks and industry trends related to cloud computing, AI, cyber security, and software engineering.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives across audit methodologies, quality assurance processes, audit technology, and reporting practices.
* Act as a trusted advisor to technology leadership on risk, governance, and control matters.
* Provide guidance and coaching to junior auditors and co-op students where applicable.

**Technical Expertise**

  

• Strong understanding of technology risk management and control frameworks including NIST, COBIT, ISO 27001, and CIS Controls.
  
• Hands-on experience auditing cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
  
• Experience reviewing DevSecOps environments, Agile delivery practices, CI/CD pipelines, and software development lifecycle controls.

* Experience using data analytics and visualization platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, Diligent/ ACL, Python, SQL, Databricks, or equivalent tools.
* Understanding AI governance, AI model risks, data quality, privacy, explainability, and responsible AI principles.
* Experience with scripting, automation, or audit technology solutions to improve assurance effectiveness.
* Knowledge of cybersecurity concepts including identity and access management, vulnerability management, logging and monitoring, and incident response.

**Professional Experience**
  
• 5-8 years of experience in IT audit, technology risk, cybersecurity, data analytics, or related assurance functions, with demonstrated experience leading complex audit engagements.
  
• Experience in financial services, asset management, wealth management, or other regulated industries is preferred.
  
• Experience working with cloud, DevSecOps, cybersecurity, and AI-related risks is required.

  

**Education and Certifications**

**Mandatory Requirements**
  
• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Science, or related field.
  
• CISA (Certified Information Systems Auditor) or CRISC (Certified in Risk and Information Systems Control)

  

**Preferred / Optional Certifications**
  
• CPA (Certified Professional Accountant) or CIA (Certified Internal Auditor)

* CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional) certification.
* CISM (Certified Information Security Manager).
    
  • CCSP (Certified Cloud Security Professional).
    
  • Microsoft Certified: Cybersecurity Architect Expert or Azure Security Engineer Associate.
    
  • ISACA Advanced in AI Audit (AAIA) or equivalent AI audit certification.
  

**Leadership and Competencies**
  
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills.
  
• Excellent written and verbal communication abilities.
  
• Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
  
• Strong stakeholder relationship management skills.
  
• High level of integrity, accountability, and professionalism.

  

**Additional Information**
  
• Hybrid work model (3 days in office per week).
  
• Occasional travel may be required.

Title: Senior Manager, Technology Risk Officer
Description:
Requisition ID: 280235
  
  
Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture.

  

The Senior Manager, Technology Risk is a first-line risk leader responsible for executing and sustaining technology risk management activities across assigned portfolios and domains. Reporting to the Director, Technology Risk Officer, this role partners closely with technology leaders, risk owners, and control functions to identify risks, assess control effectiveness, and drive remediation outcomes in alignment with risk appetite and regulatory expectations.

  

The role plays a critical part in operationalizing the Technology Risk Office’s strategy, translating risk direction, governance standards, and escalation decisions into consistent execution, high-quality evidence, and measurable risk reduction

  

**Is this role right for you? In this role you will:**

  

* Execute technology risk assessments, control self-assessments, and thematic reviews across applications, platforms, and services, ensuring risks are accurately identified, evaluated, and documented in enterprise risk systems.
* Own day-to-day issue management and remediation execution, including development and tracking of clear get-to-green plans, addressing root causes, and escalating risks or slippage with proposed actions.
* Monitor the effectiveness of key technology governance processes (e.g., SDLC, change, architecture, and project delivery) to identify control gaps and support remediation and improvement initiatives.
* Support audit and regulatory activities by coordinating evidence, preparing responses, and validating remediation outcomes; oversee SOX-related control execution within scope, including evidence readiness for quarterly attestations.
* Produce risk, control, and remediation reporting (KPIs/KRIs), highlighting trends, emerging risks, and control health to support risk-based decision-making.
* Partner with technology risk owners, Business Internal Control teams, and other control functions to strengthen first-line risk ownership, execution consistency, and risk culture.
* Lead, coach, and develop Technology Risk Officers or analysts (where applicable) to ensure high-quality execution, sound judgment, and sustained risk management outcomes.
* Champion a customer-focused culture and deepen relationships with senior leadership, peers, and functional groups.
* Ensure compliance with information security regulations, user education, and cybersecurity.
* Lead the design and operation of compliance monitoring and improvement activities to ensure compliance with internal security policies and applicable laws and regulations.
* Actively pursue effective and efficient operations, ensuring adherence to operational risk, regulatory compliance risk, AML/ATF risk, and conduct risk frameworks.
* Understand and apply the organization’s risk appetite and risk culture in day-to-day activities and decisions.
* Build a high-performance environment and implement a people strategy that attracts, retains, develops, and motivates the team..

  

**Do you have the skills that will enable you to succeed in this role? We’d love to work with you if you have:**

  

* University degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Technology, or a related field
* Professional certifications in cybersecurity, technology, or risk management (e.g., CISSP, CCSP, CEH, CISM).
* Demonstrated knowledge or hands-on experience in one or more of the following areas:
  + Regulatory (e.g., FFIEC guidance, NYS DFS, FRB, FINRA)
  + Technology (e.g., cybersecurity, software delivery, infrastructure/platform services, asset or currency management)
  + Issue & Remediation Management (e.g., execution tracking, risk evaluation, escalation, and reporting)
  + Audit or Regulatory Exam Support (e.g., control testing, evidence management, remediation coordination)
* 7 to 10+ years of experience in technology risk, cybersecurity, internal controls, audit, compliance, or operational risk within a financial services or regulated environment.
* Broad exposure across multiple technology domains, such as application development, infrastructure or cloud services, information security, resilience, third-party risk, and change or incident management.
* Experience executing remediation programs and supporting get-to-green outcomes, including coordination across technology and control partners; experience across any line of defense is preferred.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to clearly articulate risk issues, remediation status, and control gaps to technology leaders and control partners.
* Solid execution, governance, and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams, dependencies, and deadlines in a complex environment.
* Experience with risk reporting, metrics, or dashboards (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, or similar tools) is desirable.
* Working knowledge of risk and control frameworks (e.g., NIST, ISO, COBIT, ITIL, FFIEC) is desirable.
* Relevant certifications (e.g., CISA, CISM, CRISC, CISSP) are an asset but not required.

Title: Vice President, Core Infrastrucutre
Location: Global Village, Dubai, United Arab Emirates
Description:
***Posting Type***
Hybrid
  
  
**Job Overview**
Rel aiR is the high-scale, secure, and defensible platform where legal data lives. It runs on infrastructure that has to be available, economical, and compliant in every region we serve. We hold more than 100 petabytes of customer data today, and we are building for hundreds of petabytes in the next three years, scaling potentially to an exabyte within five. This is sensitive data at scale, and managing it requires a global understanding of data management.
  
  
The load is rising from multiple directions at once. More legal work is being done with the help of AI-driven software. AI is supporting more use cases across Legal Data Intelligence. MCP (Model Context Protocol) and third-party builder programs are automating more workflows. And we are moving all new matters to Rel aiR. Together these have taken the AI results we produce from millions to hundreds of millions, and we are headed to billions.
  
  
We are hiring a Vice President of Core Infrastructure to build the foundation for that growth and to join the leadership team of Engineering at Relativity. You will own SQL platform, compute (Kubernetes), reliability and operations, and incident and problem management, and build a new capacity-forecasting function.
  
  
Your strategy will span multiple data centers and multiple ways to store data. You will stay agile when cloud storage capacity is tight, adapt to data sovereignty and local requirements around the world, and work with Security to keep the fortress secure. You will work with engineering teams to raise utilization and route work to the resources available, and you will make sure we use services that meet our economic targets, and use them well.
  
  
**Job Description And Requirements**
**This is a builder’s job.**
We are 25 years old and, in many ways, still a startup. We are growing fast, and the infrastructure we need for the next five years does not exist yet. You will not inherit a mature platform to operate. You will build the strategy, the talent, and the capacity engine while the platform carries production traffic. Our Cloud Native Transformation is re-platforming Rel aiR so that every matter, including the largest and most complex, runs on a cloud-native foundation, and it depends on what you will lead. We need your help to build it and to execute it.
  
  
**What Success Looks Like**

* Reliability customers can feel. Availability and recovery that match the trust customers place in us, with fewer severe incidents and faster resolution.
* Infrastructure with options. Storage and compute across multiple data centers and multiple ways to store data, with the agility to shift when cloud capacity is constrained.
* Global by design. Data placement and operations that meet data sovereignty and local requirements wherever our customers are.
* A secure fortress. Infrastructure and security decisions made together, with a close and trusted relationship between your organization and Security.
* Efficient use of capacity. Engineering teams use resources more fully, work routes to the capacity that is available, and the services we choose meet our economic targets and are used appropriately.
* Infrastructure that carries the transformation. The data and compute platform keeps pace with the Cloud Native Transformation, and structural change ships in steady increments.
* One owner from detection to fix. Incident response and problem management sit in one organization, and the same root causes stop recurring.
* A strong teammate across Engineering. You help set direction beyond your own domain and are known as a leader inside the company and across the industry.

**What You’ll Do**

* Set the vision. Define what infrastructure for a leading data company looks like, and bring your organization and your peers along.
* Own reliability end to end. Observability, site services, on-call, incident response, and problem management sit with you.
* Build the storage and compute strategy. Multiple data centers, multiple storage options, and the capacity model that shows where each choice breaks as data grows toward an exabyte.
* Manage cost as part of the job. Own the economics of the services we use, and work with Finance on how storage and AI costs affect gross margin.
* Partner with Security. Keep the fortress secure through shared priorities, shared roadmaps, and clear ownership.
* Work with engineering teams. Raise utilization, route work to available resources, and adapt to cloud storage availability and to local requirements.
* Build the organization. Recruit the leaders, set the operating rules, and decide the mix of in-house and contract teams.
* Lead across Engineering. Work daily with the leaders of data pipelines, security, AI products, and the builder platform, and take a seat in decisions that reach beyond your domain.
* Use AI to run production. Apply AI to detection, root-cause analysis, and remediation.
* Stay in touch with the details. Operate comfortably at 1,000 feet and at ground level. Go deep on a root-cause analysis or a customer escalation and find the cause. Walk to a whiteboard and sketch the architecture, including where it breaks.

**Required**
**What You Bring**

* A builder’s record. You have built strategy and talent in a fast-growing company, not only operated a mature platform.
* SaaS operations at scale. A record of running infrastructure and site reliability for a multi-tenant SaaS platform with demanding availability commitments and petabytes of customer data.
* Global data management. Experience placing and operating sensitive data across multiple regions and data centers, and meeting data sovereignty and local requirements.
* Infrastructure leadership. Led organizations of 100+ engineers across SRE, database platform, and container platform disciplines, including contractor teams.
* Cost and capacity economics. You have managed infrastructure cost against economic targets, and made build-versus-buy decisions on storage or compute at petabyte scale.
* Cloud-native depth. Kubernetes, SQL at scale, and a major public cloud. Hyperscale cloud provider experience is valuable.
* Incident leadership. You have reduced severe incidents and time to resolve in a large organization.
* Technical credibility. You can challenge an architecture, a capacity forecast, and an incident review on the merits.

**Valuable But Not Required**

* Regulated or FedRAMP-authorized environments.
* Experience with eDiscovery or other large document platforms.
* Experience in a private equity-backed company or one preparing for an IPO.

**Why Join Us**

* Own the infrastructure under the largest legal data footprint in the world, and build it for an exabyte.
* Join a 25-year-old company that still moves like a startup, with the mandate to shape the strategy and the team.
* Report to the CTO and sit on the Engineering leadership team, with direct access to the executive team and the board.
* Run a platform where an outage delays litigation, investigations, and regulatory deadlines for customers.
* Competitive compensation, including equity participation in a private equity-backed company at an inflection point.

**Relativity is committed to competitive, fair, and equitable compensation practices.**
This position is eligible for total compensation which includes a competitive base salary, an annual performance bonus, and long-term incentives.
  
  
The expected salary range for this role is between following values:
  
  
$240,000 and $360,000
  
  
The final offered salary will be based on several factors, including but not limited to the candidate's depth of experience, skill set, qualifications, and internal pay equity. Hiring at the top end of the range would not be typical, to allow for future meaningful salary growth in this position.
  
  
**Required Skills**
Budget Management, Cloud Native, Cloud-Native Architecture, Cloud-Native Computing, Data Management, Data Science, Engineering Management, Innovation, Leadership, Product Management, Project Management, Risk Management, Software as a Service (SaaS), Software Development, System Designs

Title: Senior Manager - Operational Readiness - AA9

* Designing handover governance and applying it consistently across systems, vendors and projects
* Service transition and operational onboarding expertise
* Planning knowledge transfer and developing operational competency
* Commercial awareness of support contracts, warranties and third-party obligations
* Clear risk reporting, decisive escalation and confident chairing of reviews
* Proven experience across core ICT infrastructure domains, including compute, storage, backup, networking and structured cabling

* Define and manage the handover governance framework for District ICT systems entering live operations.
* Establish required handover deliverables, review checkpoints, sign-off criteria, and escalation principles.
* Ensure handover governance is applied consistently across different District ICT Systems, vendors, and projects.

* Ensure support workflows, service structures, escalation paths, and operational contacts are established before go-live.

Title: Executive Director, Utilities (RE1)
Description:
The Executive Director, Utilities leads the City Operations utilities mandate across Qiddiya City, covering power, potable water, renewed water, wastewater, stormwater, ICT, water bodies, lagoons and other utility systems within scope. The role is accountable for improving the operational management and resilience of existing interim networks, water bodies and lagoons; protecting continuity of service during construction; defining the city-wide utilities strategy, ownership model and operating standards; and ensuring permanent utility and water assets are planned, designed, delivered and accepted in line with City Operations and Qiddiya City Authority requirements. Reporting to the City Chief Operations Officer, the role coordinates closely with planning, design, delivery, district and asset teams, QTech, Smart City, utility providers, regulators and O&M partners to manage material service, capacity, water-quality, commercial and reputational risks.

**Utilities Strategy and Asset Ownership**

* Develop and implement the City Operations strategy for all utilities, water bodies and lagoons, including service outcomes, water quality, resilience, governance, ownership, operating and cost model, standards and long-term investment priorities.
* Determine which interim and permanent utility assets will be adopted by City Operations and which will be owned or operated by utilities, districts, assets or other third parties, with clear decision rights and accountability.
* Improve the operational management, asset information, condition oversight and service performance of existing interim power, potable water, renewed water and ICT networks.
* Develop and implement a protection and continuity strategy for live interim utility networks during construction, recognising that outages create a material operational and reputational risk for Qiddiya.
* Maintain an accurate city-wide utilities asset register and GIS record, including surveys of existing interim networks and requirements for any relocation arising from development works.
* Advise the City Chief Operations Officer and governance on utility priorities, delivery dependencies, capacity constraints, temporary solutions, investment needs and material operational risks.

**Planning, Design and Operational Assurance**

* Coordinate with planning, design and delivery teams to accelerate permanent utility assets needed for growing city-wide operational, development and major-event requirements.
* Define City Operations requirements and assure their incorporation into utility strategies, project briefs, designs, specifications, delivery plans and permanent-asset operating models.
* Verify that interim and full-build infrastructure can meet peak utility loads, including concurrent major-event scenarios and increased city footfall, with adequate redundancy and recovery arrangements.
* Lead operational assurance of critical dependencies and interfaces, including permanent and temporary power, potable and renewed water capacity, wastewater, stormwater, water bodies and lagoons, utility corridors, ICT connectivity and data-centre requirements.
* Coordinate space planning for utility operational centres, O&M yards, workshops and equipment and spare-parts storage, confirming the required number, location and functionality across Qiddiya City.
* Participate in multidisciplinary stage-gate reviews and challenge solutions to optimise safety, service continuity, maintainability, whole-life cost, efficiency and operational readiness.

**Readiness, Handover and Asset Acceptance**

* Establish utility readiness, testing, commissioning, handover and operational acceptance requirements, including permits, asset data, GIS records, operating procedures, warranties, spares, training and defect closure.
* Assess acceptance evidence and recommend City Operations acceptance only where ownership, operating responsibility, funding and service interfaces are clear.
* Aggregate city-wide O&M requirements and lead the technical and operational strategy for a multi-year city-wide utilities O&M services procurement, coordinating with Commercial, Procurement, Finance and Legal.
* Coordinate mobilisation and transition arrangements for interim and permanent networks, including temporary service extensions where delays to permanent assets require continued use of temporary power, water or ICT solutions.
* Ensure adopted assets are captured in the asset management system and GIS with complete, accurate and usable information for safe operation and maintenance.

**Performance, Risk and Lifecycle Management**

* Establish KPIs and executive reporting for availability, outages, reliability, water quality, water-body and lagoon condition, capacity, losses, consumption, compliance, incidents, cost, complaints and recovery performance.
* Maintain a consolidated utilities risk and dependency register covering delivery slippage, temporary-network fragility, corridor and land constraints, capacity shortfalls, construction interfaces and unbudgeted temporary solutions.
* Develop lifecycle, renewal and investment plans based on criticality, condition, service demand, resilience, regulatory requirements and whole-life value.
* Confirm the operational data required for smart utilities, align the Siemens utilities integration study with QTech and Smart City initiatives, and define requirements for monitoring, analytics and future digital-twin capability.
* Ensure emergency, outage, business continuity and recovery plans are coordinated with City Operations, districts, assets, utility providers, safety, security and event functions.

**Commercial, Regulatory and Stakeholder Management**

* Define the utilities cost-recovery model, including cost allocation, metering, tariffs or charges, billing inputs, subsidy requirements, subsidy period and governance for costs levied on operational assets.
* Lead the utility component of the city service charge in collaboration with the Executive Director, City Asset Management and Finance and Control, ensuring transparent and auditable recovery mechanisms.
* Draft and implement service level agreements between City Operations and districts or assets for utilities adopted by City Operations, including service standards, responsibilities, escalation, outage communication and performance reporting.
* Develop City Operations codes, standards and guidelines for construction in the vicinity of live utility assets, including permits, protection measures, access controls and incident response.
* Manage strategic interfaces with authorities, regulators, Saudi Electricity, water entities, telecoms providers, developers, districts, operators and specialist O&M service providers.
* Ensure statutory, technical, environmental, commercial and contractual obligations are identified, governed and evidenced across all adopted utilities.

**Leadership and Capability Building**

* Build and lead a capable municipal utilities team with clear accountability, effective governance and disciplined delivery.
* Develop Saudi talent through structured recruitment, mentoring, role exposure, succession planning and knowledge transfer from advisers, delivery partners and operators.
* Promote collaboration, technical rigour, commercial discipline, innovation and continuous improvement.

  
**Requirements**

**Education and Professional Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, utilities, infrastructure, asset management or a related discipline.
* Postgraduate qualification in engineering, asset management, business or a related field is advantageous.
* Relevant professional registration or accreditation in engineering, utilities, asset management or project management is preferred.

**Experience**

* Substantial executive leadership experience in city-wide utilities, infrastructure asset management or utility network development within a complex city, municipality, mixed-use destination or major development programme.
* Demonstrated experience managing live interim or temporary utility networks while permanent infrastructure is planned and delivered in an active construction environment.
* Strong experience across utility strategy, planning, design assurance, construction interfaces, testing, commissioning, handover, operational acceptance and service mobilisation.
* Proven experience in network resilience, outage management, peak-demand planning, lifecycle investment, GIS and asset information, operational data and regulatory compliance.
* Demonstrated experience developing utility O&M procurement strategies, SLAs, performance regimes, tariffs, metering, billing, cost-recovery or subsidy models.
* Proven ability to manage interfaces among developers, delivery teams, authorities, regulators, utilities, districts, operators and service providers; experience in Saudi Arabia or the wider GCC is strongly preferred.

**Technical and Functional Expectations**

* Expert understanding of city-wide utility asset management, live-network operations and governance of networked infrastructure.
* Strong working knowledge of power, potable water, renewed water, wastewater, stormwater, water bodies and lagoons, ICT and associated corridors, facilities and operational dependencies.
* Ability to assess demand, capacity, reliability, redundancy, pressure and flow constraints, metering, efficiency, service continuity, emergency recovery and whole-life cost.
* Strong understanding of GIS, asset registers, operational technology, smart-utility data, analytics and digital-twin opportunities.
* Clear understanding of asset-owner, developer, regulator, network operator, O&M manager, district, asset and service-provider accountability boundaries.
* Strong commercial judgement, procurement capability, risk management, data-led decision-making and executive reporting.

Title: Senior Account Manager
Description:
At **OpensDoors**, we believe great account management is about far more than keeping clients happy. It’s about understanding their ambitions, owning their results and becoming a trusted extension of their commercial team. We are looking for a commercially driven experienced Senior Account Manager who also has experience in Business Development.

This is a **hybrid job** 3 days in the office - Jumeirah Lake Towers and 2 Working From Home.

**Salary**: AED 100,000 - 125,000 basic per year + uncapped commission | OTE AED 300,000+ per year. Commission is where you will make your money!

We’re looking for an **Senior** **Account Manager – UAE** who is commercially driven, proactive and genuinely motivated by client success. Someone who takes ownership, spots opportunities, solves problems and isn’t afraid to get hands-on when results need a push.

We are looking for someone who can lead by example and is an out and out target driven person. **Business Development will be a key aspect of this role as well as Account Managing and leading the rest of the UAE team.**

You’ll manage a portfolio of clients with their targets, KPIs and commercial objectives becoming your own measures of success.

**Their targets are your targets. Their success is your success.**

**The Role**

You’ll be the day-to-day owner of your client relationships, working closely with senior stakeholders to understand their business, target markets and growth objectives.

You’ll coordinate with our **Campaign, Telemarketing, Networking, Research, LinkedIn and wider delivery teams across the UK and UAE** to make sure clients are getting the results they expect.

And when an account needs more momentum, you won’t simply delegate it.

You’ll get involved — picking up the phone, prospecting, using LinkedIn, following up opportunities and doing whatever is commercially sensible to help move the account forward.

This is a role for someone who enjoys **ownership, pace, variety and measurable results**.

Responsibilities: **Own Your Client Relationships and Build New Client Relationships**

* Business Development - picking up the phone, networking and driving new business.
* Manage a portfolio of UAE-based client accounts.
* Build trusted relationships with senior decision-makers and key stakeholders.
* Understand each client's proposition, priorities, target markets and growth objectives.
* Become a genuine extension of each client's commercial team.
* Keep communication proactive, clear and commercially focused.
* Identify and address concerns before they become relationship risks.

**Own Performance & Results**

* Generate New Business
* Take full ownership of agreed client targets and KPIs.
* Continuously monitor activity, pipeline and opportunities.
* Quickly identify when performance is falling behind — and take action.
* Work collaboratively with UK and UAE delivery teams to improve outcomes.
* Get hands-on when required, including prospecting, calling, LinkedIn outreach and opportunity follow-up.

**Lead Reporting & Account Governance**

* Maintain accurate records of activity, opportunities, pipeline and outcomes.
* Produce clear and commercially useful KPI reporting.
* Lead regular client review meetings.
* Use client meetings to agree actions, recommend changes and keep strategy aligned.
* Provide concise portfolio updates to the Global Board of Directors.

**Retain & Grow Your Accounts**

* New Account Development
* Build relationships that lead to long-term client partnerships.
* Proactively manage renewals, extensions and rollovers.
* Identify renewal risks early and put recovery plans in place.
* Demonstrate the tangible commercial value OpensDoors delivers.
* Identify appropriate opportunities for additional services, capacity, territories and service lines.

**What We're Looking For**

We’re looking for someone who combines **strong relationship skills with genuine commercial drive**.

You may come from account management, client services, business development or another commercially focused role. What matters most is that you know how to build relationships, take accountability and deliver against targets.

You’ll ideally bring:

* Proven experience managing multiple client relationships and commercial KPIs.
* Strong account management, client services or business development experience.
* Excellent communication, presentation and stakeholder-management skills.
* Confidence using the telephone, LinkedIn, CRM systems and other business development channels.
* A highly organised, proactive and accountable approach.
* Commercial curiosity and the ability to identify opportunities.
* A willingness to roll up your sleeves and get involved when results demand it.
* Experience of the **UAE/GCC business environment** is advantageous.
* Experience within **Facilities Management, Built Environment, Construction, Property or Hospitality** would be particularly valuable.

If that sounds like you, we'd like to hear from you.

**Their targets are your targets.**  
**Their success is your success.**  
**Their long-term partnership with OpensDoors is the ultimate measure of your success.**

**Apply now to join OpensDoors as Account Manager – UAE.**
