Title: Field Operations Manager I, Plant Maintenance
Description:
At gFiber, we believe that great internet has the power to drive innovation, strengthen communities, enable the impossible, and do all the everyday things that make all of our world go round. And the job of creating better internet is never done - so we're growing! Our team is committed to building a place where people who want to make a difference can grow their careers and find their spot to belong.

**This role is not eligible for immigration sponsorship.**

The application window will be open until at least **November 29th, 2026**. This opportunity will remain online based on business needs which may be before or after the specified date.

  

**Role Description**

As the Field Operations Manager I, you will oversee all field support, splitting time between the central office and field, for local operations, including planning, coaching, scheduling, and coordination of all team activities. You'll oversee a team that includes Construction Technicians, OSP Plant Maintenance Technicians I and II, and Residential Installers. Using your experience of Fiber to the Home (FTTH), Gigabit Passive Optical Network (GPON), 10 Gigabit Passive Optical Network (XGS) network construction, you will ensure the internal team and vendors understand the proper methods for installation, maintenance, and repair of network infrastructure as well as safety standards like Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA). In this management role, you'll also focus on resolving complex interactions between customers and team members, making sure everyone feels heard and process iteration occurs.

**In this role, you'll:**

**Field Operations Leadership:**

* Lead and manage a team of technicians, overseeing all aspects of field operations including planning, scheduling, and coordinating construction, installation, repair, and maintenance activities.
* Foster team development by actively promoting best practices, identifying skill development opportunities, and creating personalized plans for individual growth.

**Technical Expertise:**

* Troubleshoot and resolve service issues across the network, from the central office to customer premises.
* Possess proficiency in various technical tasks like installing Ethernet jacks, making telecom space cross-connects, and handling radio installations, maintenance, and troubleshooting.

**Customer Service:**

* Navigate complex customer interactions with exceptional client service, professionalism, and thoroughness.
* Communicate effectively with internal colleagues and external customers.
* Cultivate relationships with property managers and building owners through advanced technical knowledge, effective communication, and collaboration.

**Teamwork and Leadership:**

* Execute operational processes and procedures with attention to detail.
* Foster a culture of continuous learning by collaborating with team members to achieve proficiency in troubleshooting complex issues affecting network connectivity and inside wiring.

**Additional Responsibilities:**

* Ability to work non-standard working hours, including nights, weekends, holidays, and varying shifts, and be willing to travel domestically up to 10% of the time.

**At a minimum we'd like you to have:**

* 5 years of experience in Fiber to the Home (FTTH)/ Gigabit Passive Optical Network (GPON)/ 10 Gigabit Passive Optical Network (XGS) network construction and/or large scale fiber network deployments.
* 5 years of experience managing relationships with contractors and suppliers.
* 3 years in a people manager position.
* Experience with physical layer components of networking infrastructure, including twisted pair copper cabling (Category 5 or greater), 66 blocks, 110 blocks, patch panels, fiber optic cabling, etc.
* Ability to lift/move up to 50lbs of equipment as required.
* Valid driver's license.
* Ability to pass a motor vehicle record check that meets company standards.
* Ability to work non-standard working hours as needed including nights, weekends, holidays, and differing work rotations/shifts as well as 10% domestic travel.

**It's preferred if you have :**

* 5 years of experience in building and operating fiber networks for business-to-business (B2B) and enterprise environments.
* Experience interfacing with local pole owners and utility companies, coordinating with city/local permitting offices, and subject matter expertise in outside plant Fiber to the Home (OSP FTTH) deployments with experience in service drop installations.
* Experience troubleshooting Ethernet network issues related to routers, switches and hubs.
* Experience with rack and stack work, assembling server stanchions, telemetry closet work (MPOE, DMARC, etc.), and patch panels.
* Ability to operate Google Workspace and Salesforce applications.

Title: Senior Manager - TSE and Wastewater SU7
Description:

Qiddiya is seeking an experienced water operations professional to manage the safe, reliable and cost-effective operation and maintenance of assigned treated sewage effluent (TSE), potable water (PW) and wastewater plants and networks.

Reporting to the Director – Water and Wastewater, you will coordinate operational teams and service providers, maintain service continuity and water quality, and support the readiness and long-term reliability of essential water infrastructure.

* Manage operating schedules and preventive and corrective maintenance across assigned plants, pumping stations, storage and networks.

* **7+ years’ experience** in water and wastewater operations and maintenance, including management of TSE and potable water services, wastewater collection or treatment, and supervision of operational teams or contractors.
* Experience managing maintenance programmes across large estates, mixed-use developments or comparable complex portfolios.
* Experience in water-quality monitoring, treatment performance, contractor supervision, budget monitoring, handover and incident coordination.
* Any mandatory registration or operating authorisation must match the assigned duties.

**Preferred / Desirable**

* Relevant postgraduate qualification in water and wastewater engineering, maintenance or asset management.
* Relevant professional engineering accreditation, where appropriate.
* Certification in water and wastewater operations, treatment, water quality, maintenance or asset management.

Title: MANAGER, CUSTOMER TECHNOLOGY IMPLEMENTATIONS
Description:
**WHO WE ARE**

GreenShield is a proudly Canadian, national non-profit health care and insurance organization, driven by our mission of Better Health for All. We believe health care is a right, not a privilege, and we are committed to improving health outcomes, advancing health equity, and building a future where every Canadian can reach their full health and well-being potential.

Through our unique integrated payer-provider ("payvider") model, we offer insurance, administer benefits, and pay claims as a ‘payer’ while offering health care services such as mental health, pharmacy, telemedicine, and chronic disease management as a ‘provider’. As a non-profit social enterprise without shareholders, we reinvest our excess earnings to directly support underserved communities. Through GreenShield Cares, we positively impacted the health and well-being of over one million Canadians between 2020 and 2025. What’s driving us now is the commitment to measurably impact an additional three million Canadians by 2030 – across mental health, essential medicines, and chronic disease management – through scalable initiatives that deliver meaningful change in pursuit of our mission of Better Health for All.  
  
At GreenShield, our culture is where purpose meets passion and performance. Our teams work as one to deliver meaningful, measurable impact for the people and communities we serve.

**THE ROLE IN A NUTSHELL**

GreenShield is seeking a customer-focused and experienced Manager, Customer Technology Implementations to lead the delivery of customer-facing technology implementations across the organization.

Reporting to the Director, Technology Project Management Office, this role will oversee a team of technology project managers responsible for coordinating complex implementations for new and existing customers and partners. The portfolio will include implementations supporting GreenShield’s Third Party Administration business, white-labelled GS+ solutions, new customer onboarding, Single Sign-On integrations, API integrations, customer migrations, and other technology-enabled partner solutions.

The Manager will provide clear leadership and accountability across the full implementation lifecycle, from early intake, discovery, requirements definition, and planning through build, testing, launch, stabilization, and transition to operations. Title: Locating Operations Manager
Description:
**Company / division** Danella Line Services, Inc.

**Location** Delaware, field-based (service area: Delaware and Maryland's Eastern Shore, Cecil and Harford counties)

**Employment type** Full-time, on-site/field

**Reports to** Regional Manager, Delaware

**About the Role**
==================

At Danella, we believe in developing and retaining the best people and providing the best value services to our customers. We take pride in everything we do to maintain the nation's infrastructure by connecting people and resources.

Danella is hiring a Locating Operations Manager for our Locating Division, based in Delaware. Our locators mark underground electric, gas, fiber and telecom facilities for utility and cooperative customers across Delaware and Maryland. This position runs day-to-day locating operations so that every 811 ticket is completed safely, on time and profitably.

The Locating Operations Manager works directly with the Regional Manager, a team of locate supervisors, the field workforce, and our accounting and payroll staff. You will be responsible to manage the daily numbers: tickets completed, production per locator, overtime, timesheets, idle time, ticket deadlines and billing data. This role suits a hands-on leader who is able to hold supervisors accountable and develop teams.

**Responsibilities**
====================

The Locating Operations Manager is responsible for meeting our customers' on-time, quality and safety requirements while controlling labor cost. Strong communication with supervisors, locators, accounting and leadership is essential.

* Lead daily locating operations for 80+ locators and a team of locate supervisors across Delaware and Maryland
* Run a daily operations meeting with supervisors to review the prior day's production, overtime, idle time and open tickets, and assign follow-up
* Set clear production expectations (tickets per locator per day and per hour) and coaching locators who fall short of safety or production
* Monitor ticket boards through the day, rebalance workloads, reassign tickets when locators call out, and route emergency tickets to the closest available locator
* Manage ticket due times and extensions to meet on-time requirements and avoid late-ticket and no-response penalties, including end-of-day board checks on a rotating evening and weekend schedule
* Make daily overtime decisions based on production data: approve overtime where it protects on-time performance, and limit it where it does not
* Review and approve locator timesheets daily, verify hours against vehicle telematics, correct discrepancies, and make sure timesheets are submitted on time
* Maintain the daily roster of who is working, off, called out, in training or on hourly assignments
* Track idle time, late starts and mileage by locator, and follow up on outliers with supervisors
* Prepare weekly and monthly billing data by customer, including ticket counts, billing codes, emergency and after-hours work, and over-footage extra charges, and reconcile ticket-system data with accounting before invoicing
* Know the terms of each customer contract (on-time targets, extra-charge rules, audit, damage and penalty terms) and bring pricing or commercial questions to company leadership
* Review customer KPI reports and penalty notices each month, check them against our own data, and prepare disputes where the data supports one
* Recruit, onboard and train locators and supervisors, including trainee rotations and refresher training
* Promote a safe work environment, including safe vehicle parking and idling practices, highway work zones and required safety sweeps
* All other duties as assigned

  

**Qualifications**
==================

What is required:

* 3+ years of experience in leading underground utility locating or damage prevention programs
* Working knowledge of 811 / One Call processes, ticket due times, extensions and marking standards; experience with Miss Utility tickets in Delaware or Maryland strongly preferred
* Experience managing to production and on-time KPIs on unit-price or production-based contracts
* Experience with a ticket management system
* Comfort working from live data: dashboards, timesheet systems and vehicle telematics with strong Microsoft Excel skills
* Willingness to learn new software, including AI-assisted reporting tools
* Valid driver's license with a clean driving record
* Ability to pass a background screening, physical and drug test
* Strong supervisory, leadership and team management skills
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including difficult conversations about performance
* Strong organizational skills, with attention to detail and accuracy
* Calm, steady and solutions-focused under pressure
* Highly responsible, accountable and dependable

**Availability**
================

* Full-time, field-based role with daily travel across Delaware and Maryland
* Participation in a rotating evening and weekend on-call schedule for end-of-day ticket board checks and urgent tickets

**Workplace Policy**
====================

Danella maintains a workplace that is completely free of drugs and alcohol, and employees are subject to random drug testing.

**What We Offer You**
=====================

* Paid on-the-job technical and professional training
* Defined career path for future growth
* Competitive wages and great benefits, including a 401(k) plan match

Title: Broker Relationship Manager

The primary objective is to expand the broker network, generate business opportunities, drive product awareness and achieve IPMI business targets through effective broker engagement and relationship management.

* 4–7 years of experience in the UAE insurance industry.
* Prior experience working with an insurance company, preferably in Broker Relationship Management, Intermediary Sales, Distribution or Business Development.
* Experience managing and developing relationships with insurance brokers and intermediaries.
* Exposure to medical insurance or IPMI products is highly preferred.
* Good understanding of the UAE insurance market and broker distribution channels.

**Key Competencies:**

* Strong broker relationship management and networking skills.
* Business development and sales conversion capabilities.
* Excellent communication, presentation and negotiation skills.
* Strong understanding of insurance products and distribution channels.
* Ability to independently develop business opportunities and achieve targets.
* Strong follow-up, coordination and stakeholder management skills.

Title: Sr. Manager, Professional Services - Pipeline Software Suite (Hybrid Work Model)

**Location: Houston, TX or Dallas, TX**
**Model of Work: Hybrid**
Are you excited by challenges? Do you enjoy working in a fast-paced, international and dynamic environment? Then now is the time to join Quorum Software, a rapidly growing company and industry leader in oil & gas transformation, and one that is reinventing itself as the AI platform for the energy industry.
  
  
Quorum Software is the world's largest provider of digital technology focused solely on business workflows that empower the next evolution of energy. From emerging companies to supermajors, throughout every region of the globe, customers rely on Quorum's proven innovation and unmatched global expertise to streamline business operations and make data-driven decisions that optimize profitability and growth. Our industry-leading solutions are transforming energy companies across the entire value chain, helping visionary leaders evolve their organizations into modern energy companies.
  
  
**Overview**
Serve as a People Leader in the Global Services (GS) business unit, accountable for the successful delivery of Quorum Pipeline Transaction Management (QPTM) and the broader Pipeline Software Suite for midstream customers. QPTM is Quorum's enterprise-grade pipeline transaction management system, used by pipeline and storage operators to manage nominations, scheduling, capacity rights, imbalances, invoicing and settlement, and regulatory compliance. You will lead the team that implements, upgrades and optimizes it for some of the most recognized names in North American midstream.
  
  
**Why This Role, Why Now: Quorum’s Platform Transformation**
Quorum is in the middle of a major transformation. Our vision is to serve as the operating system for the global energy industry: a unified platform where every domain, from subsurface planning to supply chain execution, is connected through a common data foundation and a governed AI layer. We are investing heavily in bringing AI and analytics into the platform, and expanding through strategic acquisitions such as Streamba, an AI-native supply chain platform, announced in June 2026. As this platform evolution reaches our pipeline solutions, Global Services will be on the front line, helping customers move from systems that simply record transactions to a connected, data-driven platform that helps run their operations. This is a rare chance to shape how that transformation is delivered to our pipeline customers and to build the team and delivery model that makes it repeatable.
  
  
**Who Will Succeed In This Role**
The person who succeeds here will be both tech-savvy and deeply grounded in the oil & gas pipeline industry. You understand how a pipeline business actually runs, from nominations and scheduling to capacity release, imbalance management, contract and rate administration, invoicing, and FERC and NAESB requirements, and you can earn the respect of pipeline operators’ commercial, scheduling, accounting and IT leaders on day one. You are equally comfortable discussing cloud deployment, integration architecture, data quality and how AI and analytics can improve a pipeline workflow. You are a leader who can bridge the two worlds: translating what operators need into how the technology is configured, delivered and adopted.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead successful delivery of QPTM and Pipeline Software Suite implementations, upgrades, cloud migrations and legacy system replacements for natural gas and liquids pipeline and storage customers
* Bring deep pipeline industry knowledge to every engagement, guiding customers on scheduling, capacity, contract, imbalance, invoicing and regulatory (FERC/NAESB) processes and ensuring the solution reflects industry best practice
* Drive repeatability and consistency across pipeline implementations through standard delivery methodologies, accelerators and reusable assets
* Manage and lead a high performing team of 15+ employees, including consultants, project managers and technical resources
* Prepare the team and our customers for Quorum’s platform transformation, building fluency in AI, analytics, data and integration capabilities as they are introduced into the Pipeline Software Suite and the wider Quorum platform
* Partner with Product and Engineering to bring field insight into the roadmap, and help shape how new platform, AI and analytics capabilities are deployed with customers
* Oversee integration of QPTM with adjacent systems such as measurement (including Quorum FLOWCAL), accounting, ETRM and commercial applications to deliver an end-to-end customer solution
* Manage to quarterly customer satisfaction, revenue and project quality goals
* Manage customer satisfaction across implementation projects including managing relationships with customer leadership and acting as a trusted advisor at the executive level
* Coordinate to ensure all staffing needs are addressed, ensuring all resources are appropriately managed and utilized
* Create a positive and rewarding workplace for employees
* Monitor employee engagement and define plans to improve overall engagement and retention
* Support Sales activities, ensuring messaging for services is clearly defined and accurate
* Ensure a high degree of quality for any Services participation in Sales activities

Title: Project Manager - Program Management (St Louis)
Description:
**Description**

Burns & McDonnell is proud to be the market leader in providing program management services to the electric utility industry. As our clients focus on their capital investment in the energy delivery market, Burns & McDonnell brings a seasoned team to assist them across a variety of operational roles to ensure the needed grid improvements are executed on time and on budget. The ideal candidate will have a safety-first mindset, be dedicated to making their clients and teams successful, and take an entrepreneurial approach to their job. As programs are an extension of our clients day-to-day operations, roles within the program management track allow for frequent, often daily, client interaction. Engineers on the program management track leverage their technical expertise and education to make informed decisions in the execution of projects on behalf of our clients.

Project managers at Burns & McDonnell are a key part of our informal leadership structure. They will be expected to mentor junior staff and lead multi-disciplinary teams in the execution of our most complex projects. In the program management organization, project managers will be relied on to support the overall development of project management capabilities through the functional leadership of day-to-day task execution. Project managers may lead specific functional areas within a larger program or lead the entirety of a smaller program working directly with our clients to provide a premier client experience.

Generally, project managers in program management will pursue job responsibilities in the following areas:

**Project Management**

* Lead a cross-functional team to execute substation, transmission line, and telecommunication projects from inception through design and construction to closeout.
* Oversee 5-20 projects concurrently of varying sizes ($100k-$50M ) and voltages (4kV-765kV).
* Manage projects for schedule adherence identifying risks and requirements to successfully achieve a project’s in-service date.
* Navigate projects through client gate approval processes including presentations to senior and executive management as required by each client.
* Manage projects for financial adherence maintaining an accurate cost forecast reflecting committed and uncommitted costs for an estimate-at-completion.
* Coordinate craft labor resources with client approved vendors for construction, testing and other field activities.
* Provide regular status updates on projects by maintaining project data and routine reporting as well as meeting updates for clients.
* Lead project meetings with cost, schedule, real estate, environmental, construction and engineering resources to facilitate project execution.

**Portfolio Management**

* Develop a multi-year capital expenditure plan to support client’s replacement and betterment of electric transmission and distribution assets.
* Regular interface and coordination with project sponsor organizations to determine details of proposed plans and business justification.
* Ensure synergies across projects are incorporated into the portfolio of work to prevent scope from being duplicated or performed inefficiently.
* Monitor composition of client’s capital investment allocation to align with stated subsidiary investment targets for optimal rate of return.
* Engage with project sponsors to evaluate need-by date for realistic schedules and budgets.
* Assist with creation and compilation of rate filing support for federal and state filings.
* Review tabletop engineering estimates for accuracy and scope.
* Review project change requests (scope, In-service date, etc.) and reconcile with the existing and long-range portfolio of work.
* Interface with client’s accounting group to establish financial setup for projects.
* Create analyses & reports to assist the client in tracking, coordination, and execution of projects.
* Build baseline scopes, schedules, and budgets to be released to multiple client’s stakeholders.

**Outage/Construction Sequencing**

* Responsible for development of substation and transmission project construction lifecycles with focus on outage efficiency and constructability.
* Manage multiple projects simultaneously while meeting specified deliverable dates and expectations.
* Analyze scoping and project documents to determine boundaries of required construction within substation and within electric grid.
* Conduct site walkdowns and project calls with project team as necessary to establish an achievable construction sequence with attainable outages.
* Analyze needed outages against adjacent outages scheduled in the area.
* Create initial outage sequence to communicate proposed construction lifecycle to project team.
* Coordinate with drafting resources to create engineering-caliber drawings that document the evolution of a project from present conditions to final state, and all needed incremental steps.
* As part of the Burns & McDonnell team we are looking for team members that foster a culture based on our MacCulture Principles, quality, diversity, and inclusion to enhance team cohesion and camaraderie. Individuals who want to tackle new and novel challenges within the utility industry to help our clients improve the execution of capital investment work can find entrepreneurial opportunities to assist in the pursuit and expansion of our program management offerings.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor Degree in engineering, construction management or related degree from accredited program required.
* Minimum of seven years of experience in engineering design, project management or a relevant role required.
* Completion of P.E., PMP, MBA or comparable advanced degree strongly preferred.
* Excellent facilitation, collaboration, organization, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to thoughtfully and positively influence, lead and manage.
* Strong planning and analytical skills.
* E.I.T. or PE license strongly preferred.
* Must demonstrate superb oral and written communication skills, strong interpersonal skills, and the ability to clearly and effectively present complex information to all levels of employees, management, and clients.
* Demonstrated success in project management which includes proposal development, contract negotiations, project planning, team leadership, budgeting, schedule management, and client coordination.
* Proven ability to develop business and establish relationships with clients.
* Travel 15-25% depending on project assignment and client needs.

Title: Senior Project Manager
Description:
**About Us**

Proserv is a global controls technology company with a heritage stretching back more than 60 years. We provide industry-leading solutions to improve the reliability, optimise the performance and extend the life of critical infrastructure across the energy sector.

Our team not only has the talent and technological expertise to deliver these transformative goals, but day-to-day, we hold to a clear set of FRESH Proserv values that underpins everything we do around the world.

So, if you believe you not only have the skills and know-how needed for this role, and you are a team player; keen to do things the right way; possess an inquisitive and creative mind; prioritise giving top-quality service and you enjoy helping and collaborating with colleagues or clients – then we really want to hear from you.

**What You Need to Know**

The Senior Project Manager is responsible for the safe, compliant, and profitable delivery of Proserv's Wellhead Control Panel (WHCP), Hydraulic Power Unit (HPU), and associated topside control system projects, from contract award through to final close-out.

Serving as the primary point of contact for clients, the role leads multidisciplinary project teams and coordinates activities across engineering, supply chain, manufacturing, quality, document control, logistics, finance, and field services to ensure successful project execution. The Senior Project Manager is accountable for managing scope, schedule, cost, quality, risk, and cash flow, while driving performance and ensuring timely decision-making throughout the project lifecycle.

The role provides technical leadership across hydraulic, mechanical, electrical, and control system disciplines, ensuring all design requirements, interfaces, battery limits, and acceptance criteria are clearly defined and effectively managed. Key project deliverables include engineering design documentation, hydraulic and electrical schematics, bills of materials, quality records, Design Verification Testing (DVT), Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), Integrated Factory Acceptance Testing (IFAT), final certification packages, and successful equipment delivery.

Working closely with clients and internal stakeholders, the Senior Project Manager plays a critical role in achieving operational excellence, customer satisfaction, and commercial success while ensuring projects are delivered safely, on time, and within budget.

**What We Are Looking For**

Some of the Key Accountabilities:

* Lead the safe, compliant, and profitable execution of Wellhead Control Panel (WHCP), Hydraulic Power Unit (HPU), and associated control system projects from contract handover through to final close-out.
* Act as the primary point of contact for clients, building strong relationships and ensuring effective communication throughout the project lifecycle.
* Develop and maintain project execution plans, ensuring delivery against agreed scope, schedule, budget, quality, and performance requirements.
* Coordinate multidisciplinary project teams across engineering, procurement, manufacturing, quality, logistics, finance, document control, and field service functions.
* Monitor and control project costs, revenue, cash flow, forecasts, risks, and change management activities to achieve commercial objectives.

Description:
**Overview**
Tonal Care runs seven days a week across an in-house Toronto team and an outsourced partner operation. The Manager, Care Operations owns how that operation performs day to day.
  
  
You will own daily delivery across all tiers, the operational relationship with our outsourced partner, and the staffing and capacity plans that keep service levels intact. You will lead a Team Lead and a team of Customer Experience Specialists, each of whom owns one or two lines of business, and you will work the queue yourself when coverage requires it.
  
  
This is a hands-on, player/coach, operating role. You set the standard, work within it, and hold the operation to it.
  
  
What You Will Do
  
  
Daily Delivery
  
  

* Act as a player-coach during the initial phase, spending dedicated time working directly in the queue alongside specialists to model best practices, coach in real time, and establish baseline workflows
* Own daily delivery across all tiers, setting service levels, coverage models, and workflow standards that hold consistent delivery across phone, email, chat, and video.
* Own the daily, weekly, and monthly plans for SLA, CSAT, Average Handle Time, and First Contact Resolution, and be accountable for hitting them.
* Identify performance trends, operational risks, and root causes, and build the action plans that close the gap.
* Lead regular performance reviews and operational business reviews with internal stakeholders and partner leadership.
* Support incident and volume management during elevated contact periods, product issues, launches, and other business disruptions.
* Work the queue yourself when coverage requires it — absences, PTO, peak volume, or an uncovered line of business. You are the final backstop on coverage.
* Translate operational data into clear insights and recommendations for Care leadership.

Outsourced Partner Performance
  
  

* Serve as the day-to-day operational point of contact for Tonal’s outsourced partner, managing performance through their team leads and supervisors.
* Hold partner leadership accountable to agreed KPIs, SLAs, quality standards, staffing commitments, and Tonal’s brand voice.
* Run weekly performance reviews with partner teams.
* Report weekly to our Logistics, Field Operations, and Care Leadership team across all Care Operations metrics.
* Partner with their leadership on performance improvement plans, staffing strategies, coaching opportunities, and operational readiness.
* Monitor partner staffing, attrition, attendance, and utilization to catch capacity risk before it reaches Members.
* Make sure partner teams are aligned to Tonal policies, workflows, and operating standards, and are prepared for new programs, product changes, and launches.
* Escalate to the Senior Manager, Care Operations when partner performance issues cannot be resolved at the working level. Contract terms, rates, and renewals sit with the Director of Care Operations.

Staffing and Capacity
  
  

* Own workforce planning with partner Workforce Management and Tonal analytics, setting capacity and staffing models against forecast demand and adjusting intraday to protect service levels.
* Plan coverage across the full seven-day operating window, including weekends, holidays, and peak periods.
* Own the volume, staffing, and partner utilization assumptions that feed Care’s operating budget.
* Monitor forecast accuracy and adjust staffing assumptions based on actual contact volume, productivity, shrinkage, and service-level performance.
* Ensure schedules keep the teams at a sustainable working load rather than at full utilization, so there is room to absorb spikes and absences.

Team Leadership
  
  

* Lead and develop the team through the Team Lead and senior specialists, owning performance calibration, coaching, career development, and coverage planning.
* Make sure every line of business has a named owner, that the assignment is understood, and that owners are held to how their domain performs.
* Be accountable for the escalations programme. Specialists and the Team Lead resolve individual escalations; you own how the programme performs and where it needs to change.
* Sit in the health, safety, and legal escalation chain: Specialist → Team Lead → Manager, Care Operations → Senior Manager, Care Operations → Director, Care Operations.
* Ensure clear ownership and communication on sensitive, complex, or high-risk Member situations.
* Monitor escalation trends to surface recurring Member pain points, and work with the frontline to reduce avoidable escalations and lift first contact resolution.

Process and Partnership
  
  

* Translate the operating plan set with the Senior Manager, Care Operations into daily execution, and own that execution.
* Work with the Care Enablement team to identify knowledge gaps and roll out new troubleshooting SOPs, training, and tool updates to the front line.
* Coordinate with Logistics and Field Operations to deliver a seamless end-to-end experience for both specialists and Members.
* Simplify workflows to reduce Member effort, improve specialist efficiency, and remove unnecessary operational friction.
* Represent Care Operations in cross-functional initiatives and launches, and support the rollout and adoption of new tools, processes, and support programs.

Coverage and Schedule
  
  
Tonal Care operates seven days a week, 9:00 AM to 10:00 PM EST. This is a hands-on leadership role and the coverage expectations come with it:
  
  

* You and your team may be required to work weekends, holidays, and after hours as coverage requires. You and your team’s schedule will shift with the needs of the operation.
* Your team will carry on-call responsibility for incidents, outages, product issues, and elevated volume periods.
* Priorities change during the day. Peak season, launches, and product escalations will change what a day looks like.

Who You Are
  
  

* You have 5+ years of experience in Customer Care, Customer Support, or Contact Center Operations, including 2+ years leading teams, vendors, or outsourced operations.
* You are operationally minded and move comfortably between the operating plan and the queue. You set the standard, then hold the operation to it.
* You have managed operational KPIs and used data to find and fix performance problems. You don’t just report numbers — you understand the why behind them and change process, staffing, or enablement to move the trend.
* You are an empathetic coach who knows how to motivate a team and can turn complex data into feedback a specialist can act on.
* You have handled complex escalations and high-impact customer situations, and you are comfortable navigating gray areas and making quick, sound decisions when they arise.
* You have strong vendor and stakeholder management skills, and can influence partners who don’t report to you.
* You are technically savvy and proficient in CRM and support tooling, with an understanding of how backend systems shape the frontline experience.
* You prioritize influence over authority, earning the trust of your team and stakeholders to drive results through collaboration rather than mandate.
* You are comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment with changing priorities and evolving processes.

Why You Will Love Working at Tonal
  
  

* You will own the operating model for a Care organization that is scaling across channels and lines of business

* Collaborative, mission-driven team with a passion for redefining strength training

**Business Operations Manager**

*• Business Development • Dubai, UAE • Justlife*

Right now, thousands of people in the UAE book a cleaner through Justlife and expect them to show up on time, do excellent work, and leave their home better than they found it. That promise only holds if the cleaners are there, trained, motivated, and routed efficiently — which means someone has to own the daily operating reality of that supply chain: keeping cleaners deployed, partners accountable, costs disciplined, and quality high.

This is an operations role, not a strategy role. You'll run the DTC home cleaning business end-to-end — 300+ cleaners across multiple partner companies, a small on-ground team of account executives and roster agents, and **measurable improvement in on-time performance, completion rates, and contribution margin within your first six months**. Every day you'll make decisions that move the numbers: which partner hires next, how to incentivise productivity, where fuel and routing waste money, whether we're hitting our supply plan. This is what it means to own a real business line.

**You'll love this role if you...**

* You think in unit economics and get frustrated when a cost lever stays hidden in a spreadsheet instead of being fixed
* You've run a large field or blue-collar workforce (directly or through partners) and know exactly how to hold external teams accountable without being their boss
* You're energised by problems you can see and touch — you'd rather spend an hour in a van or at a partner accommodation than sit in a meeting
* You build teams that work without you, and you actively coach people into bigger roles
* You obsess over data quality because you know bad reports kill decisions, and you'll learn SQL or Power BI yourself rather than wait for someone to build your dashboard

**What you'll own**

* **Drive sustained improvement in on-time %, completion rate %, promise-kept %, and absent rate %** by building daily operating discipline — reviewing metrics with the team each morning, identifying blockers, and acting on them before they compound into service failures.
* Lead and develop the on-ground operations team (2 account executives and 4 remote roster agents): set clear priorities, review performance daily, coach individuals toward higher capability, and manage accountability.
* Own supply planning and growth: forecast cleaner headcount needed against demand by city and partner, manage onboarding pace and allocation across partner companies, and reduce time-to-deployment so new hires contribute faster.
* Manage partner companies as senior counterparts: run monthly business reviews, hold them to service-level agreements and commercial terms, reconcile statements of account with finance monthly, and escalate issues before they become crises.
* Design and drive cost and process projects that improve contribution margin — incentive structure redesigns, fuel and fleet controls, van routing optimisation, cleaner orientation and training — taking each from idea to measurable result.
* Build and maintain reporting that surfaces what's driving performance: which partners are slipping, where attrition is highest, which cost levers moved margin, what's blocking supply. Act on what it shows.
* Spend meaningful time in the field — in vans, accommodations, and partner sites — so you understand problems first-hand and your team sees you do the same.

**What tells us you're the one**

* You've **measurably improved operational metrics across a large field workforce** — *tell us a specific program you ran (incentive redesign, routing optimisation, vendor onboarding, training rollout, etc.) and the metric that moved as a result: completion rate up X%, on-time performance improved Y%, attrition fell Z%, or margin lifted by N%*.
* You can spot cause and effect: when a metric moves, you know whether it's partner execution, process design, incentive misalignment, or something else — and you know how to test your hypothesis before rolling out a fix.
* You've managed blue-collar, field-based, or logistics workforces (home services, facilities management, staffing, last-mile delivery, quick commerce) — or run marketplace operations where supply quality depends on external partners. Results matter far more than years, but 5–7 years of this kind of work is the sweet spot.
* You're fluent in data: you can build operating reports independently, interrogate a spreadsheet without help, and use SQL, Power BI, or AI tools to automate manual reporting so you have time to think.
* You speak fluent English, written and spoken. Bonus: you speak languages common to the workforce in the UAE (Tagalog, Urdu, Arabic), or you have prior experience operating in the UAE market in home services, logistics, or staffing.

**Why Justlife**

* **Scale and impact:** You'll run a real, revenue-generating business line serving thousands of customers across the UAE, managing hundreds of cleaners and multiple partner companies, with direct line of sight from your decisions to customer satisfaction and margin.
* **Clear growth path:** this role is a launchpad into broader category leadership, multi-city operations, or general management as we scale across the GCC.
* **Close partnership with leadership:** you'll work alongside the Business Development lead and the founding team, with real influence on strategy and resource decisions.

Cardinal Health’s Global Medical Products and Distribution (“GMPD”) segment, focuses on U.S. and International Products and Distribution businesses. We offer industry expertise and an expanding portfolio of safe, effective medical products that improve quality, manage costs and reduce complexity. The **Director, Operational Excellence – Medical Distribution** reports to the VP, Network Operations – Medical Distribution and leads the Distribution Operating Systems, Back-Office Operational Excellence, and International Operational Excellence teams.

This leader will drive end-to-end improvements across the Medical Distribution network, leading teams of Data Scientists, Business Analysts, and Project Managers to improve service, capacity, productivity, and cost. The ideal candidate brings deep experience solving complex supply chain and distribution challenges, leading analytical and cross-functional teams, and translating data into actionable operational strategies. Experience across multiple industries is highly valued, bringing external perspectives and proven best practices that can further strengthen and modernize the Medical Distribution network.

**Responsibilities:**

* Provide thought leadership and shape the Operational Excellence strategy for the Medical Distribution network.
* Lead and develop high-performing teams across Distribution Operating Systems, Back-Office Operational Excellence, and International Operational Excellence.
* Identify and remove constraints across the end-to-end supply chain to improve service, capacity, productivity, and cost.
* Design supply chain and product-flow solutions that leverage broader organizational scale, systems, and capabilities.
* Lead capacity and throughput planning across facilities, inventory, labor, transportation, and customer delivery requirements.
* Develop solutions to operational constraints through process improvements, technology, and capital investment.
* Leverage data, analytics, and Lean Six Sigma methodologies to drive continuous improvement and measurable business results.
* Translate complex analysis into clear recommendations and influence senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Champion innovation, simplification, and standardization across processes, systems, and operating models.
* Lead multi-year strategic initiatives in a complex, matrixed organization.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Operations, Engineering, Business, Analytics, or related field, or equivalent experience, preferred.
* Lean Six Sigma Black Belt required; Master Black Belt preferred.
* Significant experience in distribution, warehouse operations, supply chain, or operational excellence.
* Experience leading analytical and operational teams.
* Strong knowledge of distribution operations, including areas such as transportation, replenishment, capacity planning, network design, and capital deployment.
* Working knowledge of Warehouse Management Systems (WMS), Labor Management Systems (LMS), Visualization Platforms (like Celonis) and other related distribution technologies.
* Strong analytical, financial, strategic planning, and problem-solving skills.
* Demonstrated success leading complex, cross-functional initiatives and influencing in a matrixed environment.
* Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Proven ability to develop talent and build high-performing teams.
* The role is based out of the U.S. with the ability to travel approximately 30%.

**Anticipated salary range:** $118,400 - $200,080

* *The salary range listed is an estimate. Pay at Cardinal Health is determined by multiple factors including, but not limited to, a candidate’s geographical location, relevant education, experience, skills and an evaluation of internal pay equity.*

**Bonus eligible**: Yes

* Medical, dental and vision coverage

Title: Agile Program Management - Director - Financial Services
Head of Project Execution, C&I Energy
Senior Program Manager
Description:
**About Citco**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
Citco is a global leader in fund services, corporate governance and related asset services, delivering end-to-end solutions and service to clients across its global organization.
  
  
**Role Purpose**
The Senior Program Manager is accountable for the strategic direction, integrated planning and end-to-end delivery performance of AXI within the Investor Relations Value Stream. In addition to the official Senior Program Manager title, the role fulfils the Value Stream Delivery Lead responsibilities for Investor Relations, ensuring that agreed outcomes and priorities are translated into a coherent roadmap, single governed backlog and measurable delivery plan.
  
  
As a member of the Investor Relations Value Stream Leadership Team, the role partners with the Value Lead, Technology Lead and Operations Lead to connect strategy with execution. The Senior Program Manager owns the overall flow and coordination of delivery, providing clear visibility of progress, capacity, cost, dependencies, risks, impediments and outcomes across AXI and related work.
  
  
As a Grade 4 leader, the Senior Program Manager operates with a high degree of autonomy and organizational influence. The role shapes delivery strategy, challenges constructively, resolves complex cross-functional constraints and represents the Value Stream in portfolio and executive forums. The position also includes formal line-management responsibility for staff within the Project Management Department, combining Value Stream delivery accountability with people leadership and capability development.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**
Investor Relations Value Stream and AXI Delivery Leadership
  
  

* Fulfil the Delivery Lead role within the Investor Relations Value Stream Leadership Team, partnering with the Value Lead, Technology Lead and Operations Lead to turn agreed outcomes and priorities into executable delivery commitments.
* Own the integrated Investor Relations Value Stream roadmap, AXI program plan, single backlog and delivery performance, ensuring investment and execution remain aligned to agreed strategic objectives and measurable business outcomes.
* Lead a complex portfolio of projects and workstreams, balancing platform development, business change, operational readiness, releases and production priorities.
* Translate strategic direction and business cases into sequenced, achievable delivery plans with clear ownership, dependencies, milestones and success measures.
* Provide direction across cross-functional and globally distributed teams, creating alignment, pace, transparency, and accountability.
* Anticipate material delivery challenges and establish practical mitigation, recovery or escalation strategies before outcomes are affected.
* Act as the senior delivery authority for AXI and the Delivery Lead for the Investor Relations Value Stream, representing delivery in Value Stream, portfolio, executive and governance forums.
* Drive consistent delivery practices, delivery metrics and continuous improvement while allowing teams to apply fit-for-purpose Agile, Waterfall or hybrid methods.
* Coordinate cross-Value Stream demand and dependencies, negotiate sequencing with shared services and escalate priority decisions where demand exceeds available capacity.
* Manage Value Stream capacity, resource demand and allocation, ensuring commitments are realistic and delivery constraints are visible early.
* Lead quarterly planning, roadmap reviews, execution reviews and delivery governance across strategic change, client work, business requests, platform change and KTLO activity.
* Maintain one visible and prioritized backlog linking Value Stream outcomes and objectives to executable epics, stories and delivery commitments, with clear ownership and no orphaned work.
* Establish and facilitate the regular Investor Relations Value Stream leadership cadence, ensuring shared ownership across value, delivery, technology and operations.

**Value Stream Delivery, Flow and Ways of Working**
Integrated Planning, Governance and Financial Control
  
  

* Develop and maintain integrated Value Stream plans, roadmaps, budgets, forecasts, capacity and resource plans, and delivery scenarios across AXI and related Investor Relations outcomes.
* Establish proportionate governance across the full delivery lifecycle, including business case, scope, schedule, financials, quality, RAID, decisions, dependencies and benefits.
* Ensure program commitments are realistic and supported by sufficient capacity, funding, technical readiness and business ownership.
* Lead Value Stream prioritization and trade-off discussions where demand exceeds capacity or where scope, sequencing, cost, dependencies or risk require leadership or executive decision.
* Provide concise, evidence-based reporting on delivery confidence, financial position, outcomes and material constraints.
* Ensure program delivery complies with applicable Project Management Department, PMO, SDLC, risk and control requirements

**Technology Delivery and Release Oversight**

* Oversee delivery across the SDLC, ensuring requirements, design, engineering, testing, UAT, performance, release and production-readiness activities are integrated and governed.
* Partner with product, business and technology leadership to maintain alignment between business outcomes, platform priorities and technical execution.
* Coordinate cross-platform, cross-program and cross-Value Stream dependencies, ensuring demand, blockers and integration risks are visible, owned, sequenced and resolved.
* Ensure releases have clear acceptance criteria, quality evidence, operational readiness, communications, implementation and support arrangements.
* Own the health of the Value Stream delivery system, using flow, quality, capacity and financial data to identify bottlenecks, remove impediments, improve predictability and support continuous improvement.
* Promote fit-for-purpose use of Agile, Waterfall and hybrid approaches rather than applying a single methodology by default.

**Executive and Stakeholder Leadership**

* Build trusted relationships with executive sponsors, business leaders, technology leaders, operations, control functions and external partners.
* Communicate complex delivery matters clearly and directly, adapting detail and recommendations to the audience.
* Present program status, risks, dependencies, investment choices and strategic recommendations to senior governance forums.
* Create a consistent program narrative across stakeholders and ensure decisions, commitments and accountabilities are understood and followed through.
* Challenge constructively where delivery confidence, scope, sequencing, ownership or expected value is unclear.
* Navigate competing priorities and organizational complexity while protecting agreed program outcomes.

**People Leadership and Project Management Capability**

* Provide formal line management for assigned staff within the Project Management Department, including regular one-to-ones, objective setting, performance and development conversations, and support for career growth.
* Set clear expectations for delivery quality, professional conduct, stakeholder management, governance and accountability.
* Allocate and balance work across direct reports, considering program priorities, individual capability, development needs and sustainable workload.
* Coach and mentor project and program management professionals, providing practical guidance on complex delivery situations and supporting sound judgement.
* Identify capability, capacity and succession needs within the team and contribute to recruitment, onboarding, talent development and retention.
* Promote consistent standards, reusable practices and knowledge-sharing across the Project Management Department and relevant communities of practice.
* Create an inclusive, collaborative environment where staff receive timely feedback, understand priorities and are supported to perform effectively.

**Measures of Success**

* Investor Relations Value Stream priorities and AXI investment are translated into one realistic, governed and outcome-focused roadmap and backlog.
* Program commitments are delivered with clear ownership, executive visibility and effective financial control.
* Material risks and dependencies are identified early, with timely decisions and credible mitigation or recovery plans.
* Business, product and technology stakeholders remain aligned on priorities, sequencing, delivery confidence and expected outcomes.
* Releases are delivered with appropriate quality, operational readiness and production support.
* Project Management Department staff have clear objectives, balanced assignments, regular feedback and meaningful development support.
* The Investor Relations Value Stream and AXI delivery teams demonstrate improving flow, predictability, transparency, collaboration and measurable value.

**Qualifications**
**Knowledge, Skills and Experience**
**Essential**

* Extensive experience leading large, complex and strategically important technology programs across multiple projects, workstreams and stakeholder groups.
* Demonstrated experience owning delivery execution, flow, planning, capacity, dependencies and governance within a Value Stream, product or comparable cross-functional operating model.
* Proven accountability for end-to-end program delivery, including strategy translation, integrated planning, governance, financial control, risk, dependency, quality and executive reporting.
* Demonstrated ability to operate autonomously, influence senior leaders and make sound decisions in ambiguous or high-pressure situations.
* Strong experience coordinating delivery across business, product, engineering, architecture, testing, operations and control functions.
* Deep understanding of SDLC and delivery methods, including Agile, Waterfall and hybrid approaches, with the judgement to tailor governance appropriately.
* Proven people-management experience, including objective setting, coaching, performance management, development planning, workload management and recruitment support.
* Experience leading and developing project or program management professionals across distributed teams.
* Excellent executive communication, facilitation, negotiation and influencing capability.
* Strong commercial and financial acumen, including budget management, forecasting, resource planning and investment trade-offs.
* Ability to connect program outputs to business outcomes, adoption and measurable value realization.

Desirable
  
  
**Personal Attributes**

* Strategic and outcome-focused, while remaining close enough to execution to intervene effectively.
* Creible and composed with senior stakeholders in complex or high-stakes situations.
* Decisive, pragmatic and willing to make delivery issues visible.
* Strong ownership mindset with high personal accountability.
* Inclusive people leader who sets clear expectations and invests in the development of others.
* Collaborative and able to lead through influence across organizational boundaries.
* Resilient, adaptable and committed to continuous improvement.

**Role Accountabilities**
The Senior Program Manager fulfils the Delivery Lead role for the Investor Relations Value Stream and owns delivery execution, flow, integrated planning, governance, financial control, dependencies and delivery performance for AXI. The Value Lead remains accountable for value, vision and priority decisions; the Technology Lead remains accountable for architecture, engineering quality and technical direction; and the Operations Lead remains accountable for operational input, readiness and adoption. The Senior Program Manager brings these perspectives together into one executable delivery system and is accountable for the effective line management and development of assigned Project Management Department staff.
  
  
**Our Benefits**
Your well-being is of paramount importance to us and central to our success. We provide a range of benefits, training and education support, and flexible working arrangements to help you achieve success in your career while balancing personal needs. Ask us about specific benefits in your location.
  
  
Citco recognizes diversity as a source of organizational pride and strength. Citco welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities, and accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

Title: Senior Manager, Travel Operation
Description:
NVIDIA redefined modern computer graphics, high performance computing, and artificial intelligence. We are known as the 'AI Computing Company.' Our GPUs power Deep Learning software frameworks, accelerated analytics, big data, modern data centers, smart cities, and autonomous vehicles. If you are forward-thinking, hardworking, and driven, and enjoy collaborating with people across countries, this job is for you.

  

We are looking for a Travel Operations Manager to join our Global Travel team, based onsite in Santa Clara, CA. You will lead a group of travel analysts dedicated to regional markets and coordinate global travel operations and the experience of those traveling. You will work closely with Finance, HR, Security, and Procurement to deliver an outstanding experience for employees worldwide. Apply now!

  

**What you will be doing:**

* Lead and develop a team of regional travel analysts across the US, EMEA, India, APAC, and Israel
* Coordinate global day-to-day traveler support, ensuring timely and high-quality service delivery
* Take responsibility for duty of care and crisis response initiatives, working alongside Global Security and HR during travel disruptions
* Drive booking compliance and travel policy enforcement across all traveler segments
* Coordinate visa programs and complex multi-leg itinerary support across regions
* Handle customer issues, itinerary changes, and non-standard travel requests for candidates, interns, executives, and VIPs
* Partner with the Meeting & Events program owner on group travel logistics, handoffs, and service continuity
* Monitor TMC service delivery and bring up performance issues to ensure SLA compliance for traveler-facing operations
* Collaborate cross-functionally with Card, Travel Supplier Management, and Concur teams on program initiatives
Develop and deliver operations metrics and traveler experience reports to Finance leadership  

  

**What we need to see:**

* 12+ overall years of experience in corporate travel management, including at least 5 years in a people management or senior leadership role
* Demonstrated experience managing global or multi-regional travel programs at scale
* Deep knowledge of Online Booking Tools and GDS systems
* Solid grasp of duty of care frameworks and crisis response within a corporate travel environment
* Experience managing TMC relationships and holding vendors accountable to SLAs
* Excellent collaborator communication skills; comfortable working with executives and cross-functional teams
* Ability to lead distributed teams across multiple time zones
* Robust analytical capabilities; skilled at developing and sharing operations metrics with leadership
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Hospitality, Finance, or a related field, or equivalent experience
Experience using AI-powered tools to streamline travel operations, automate workflows, or improve traveler experience  

  

**Ways to stand out from the crowd:**

* Experience at a technology company with a large, frequent-traveler workforce
* Familiarity with global TMC operating models
* Exposure to visa and immigration support processes
* Background with travel reporting tools, dashboards, or BI platforms
Experience supporting marketing events, corporate offsites, or large-scale employee events programs  

  

NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world's most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and dedicated people in the world working for us. If you're creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you.

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job-related factors. The expected base salary range for this position is 202,500 USD – 390,000 USD.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits .

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until November 29, 2026.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes.

NVIDIA is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

Title: Office Manager
Description:
**OFFICE MANAGER**

**Join the WESTECH Team**

WESTECH is seeking an ambitious, energetic, technology-savvy, and AI-proficient Office Manager to lead the daily operations of our Cleves, Ohio office. We're looking for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, embraces emerging technologies, enjoys solving problems, and takes pride in making an organization run efficiently.

This is more than an administrative position—it's an opportunity to become a key member of our leadership team. You'll help drive operational excellence, improve processes, support our project teams, and create an exceptional experience for employees, clients, and business partners.

If you're proactive, highly organized, love learning new technology, and are always looking for smarter, more efficient ways to get things done—including leveraging Artificial Intelligence—we'd love to meet you.

**Why WESTECH?**

At WESTECH, we don't settle for average. We set high standards, over-deliver on our commitments, and are committed to continuous improvement. We value initiative, innovation, teamwork, and people who aren't afraid to roll up their sleeves and make a difference.

We believe Artificial Intelligence is transforming the way businesses operate and are looking for someone who can help us leverage AI to improve productivity, streamline workflows, and enhance communication across our organization.

If you're looking for a career—not just a job—and want to work where your ideas and contributions matter, this could be the perfect opportunity.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Office Operations**

* Manage the day-to-day operations of the office to ensure a productive, efficient, and professional workplace.
* Identify opportunities to improve office procedures and implement better systems and workflows.
* Oversee facility maintenance, vendor relationships, and office security.

**Technology, Information Systems & Artificial Intelligence**

* Serve as the primary coordinator for office technology, computer systems, internet services, and office equipment.
* Work with IT providers to ensure systems remain secure, reliable, and up to date.
* Champion new technology, digital tools, automation, and Artificial Intelligence solutions that improve efficiency and collaboration.
* Utilize AI platforms such as ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, or similar tools to assist with document creation, communications, research, workflow automation, meeting summaries, and administrative efficiencies.
* Identify opportunities to integrate AI into daily business processes while maintaining data security and confidentiality.

**Administrative Leadership**

* Manage incoming mail, deliveries, and office communications.
* Coordinate meetings, schedules, and company events.
* Support project managers and technical staff with reports, documentation, and administrative needs.
* Use AI tools to improve document quality, presentation materials, correspondence, and organizational workflows.

**Records & Compliance**

* Maintain organized digital and physical records.
* Assist with project documentation and database management.
* Administer employee timesheets and company records.
* Notarize documents as needed.

**Human Resources Support**

* Coordinate employee onboarding and orientation.
* Track employee training, certifications, licenses, and continuing education requirements.
* Help foster a positive, engaging workplace culture.
* Assist in developing AI-enabled onboarding materials and internal documentation.

**Financial Administration**

* Prepare weekly Accounts Receivable reports for project managers.
* Manage company credit cards and expense reporting.
* Assist with various accounting and administrative functions.

**Fleet & Asset Management**

* Coordinate maintenance, registration, licensing, and records for company vehicles.
* Manage office equipment maintenance and service agreements.
* Maintain inventory of office supplies and equipment.

**What We're Looking For**

The ideal candidate is:

* Ambitious and motivated to grow professionally.
* Energetic with a positive, "can-do" attitude.
* Highly organized and exceptionally detail-oriented.
* Tech-savvy and excited by emerging technologies, proficient in using Artificial Intelligence tools.
* Passionate about finding innovative ways to automate repetitive tasks and improve business processes.
* A proactive problem solver who takes initiative.
* An outstanding communicator with excellent customer service skills.
* Able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Professional, dependable, and committed to excellence.
* Curious, adaptable, and committed to continuous learning.

**Qualifications**

* Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook).
* Experience with office technology, databases, cloud-based business software, and digital collaboration tools.
* **Demonstrated experience using Artificial Intelligence applications to improve productivity, communication, document preparation, research, data organization, or workflow automation is required.**
* Ability to quickly learn and implement new technologies.
* Strong organizational, communication, and time-management skills.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise sound judgment when using AI technologies.
* Notary Public certification in Ohio (or willingness to obtain) is a plus.

**Benefits**

* Competitive compensation
* Generous retirement plan
* Paid time off
* Health insurance compensation
* Small, close-knit team where your contributions matter
* Opportunity for professional growth and advancement
* Collaborative, supportive work environment

**Ready to Join Us?**

If you're excited about helping build a high-performing company, enjoy using the latest technology and Artificial Intelligence to improve business operations, and want to make a real impact every day, we'd love to hear from you.

Please submit your resume and a cover letter explaining how your experience—including your use of AI and modern business technologies—will help WESTECH continue to innovate and grow.

Send your application to **mwesterfield@gowestech.com**.

**WESTECH is committed to hiring exceptional people who share our passion for excellence, innovation, continuous improvement, and embracing the technologies shaping the future of business.**

Pay: $25.00 - $35.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 – 50.0 per week

Work Location: In person

Title: Market Operations Manager
Description:
**Job Description:**  
What Youll Do
  
  
As the Market Operations Manager for Trü Frü Canada, you will own inventory planning, logistics, and supply chain execution for the Canadian market from end to end.
