Title: Event & Fabrication Project Manager
Description:
**ABOUT THE SIMPLE LUXE**

The Simple Luxe is a creative services company operating two divisions under one roof.

Events Division — Full-service event planning, design, and production specializing in balloons, backdrops, brand activations, and private and corporate events. We serve clients throughout Los Angeles and Orange County.

Builds Division — Custom fabrication and carpentry including trade show booths, experiential design, custom furniture, brand activations, and retail environments. We serve clients nationwide.

We make simple, simply luxurious.

**THE ROLE**

This Project Manager will oversee both divisions, acting as the bridge between a closed sales deal and a finished product walking out the door. You will own the entire project lifecycle from handoff by sales to final delivery.

This is a key leadership role — high performance is expected from day one. The goal is to take significant day-to-day operational responsibility off the owners so they can focus on business growth, sales, and client retention. This person must not need to be told twice, must see what needs to happen before being asked, and must take real pride in the quality of what goes out the door.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Events Division**

* Own every project from the moment it transfers from sales — kickoff through final delivery
* Manage production of backdrops, painting coordination, and all fabrication deliverables
* Handle all client communications: scheduling, proofing, final sign-offs, pre- and post-project requests
* Schedule trucks, drivers, and installation crews for event days
* Coordinate with outside vendors on-site during setup
* Go into the field as needed to lead on-site setups — keeping staff and vendors aligned so the job gets done on time
* Responsible for purchasing all event materials from vendors; purchasing may be delegated to the appropriate associate responsible for that area
* Maintain quality standards throughout every stage of production

**Builds Division**

* Own all build projects end-to-end — start to finish, no handoffs
* Responsible for purchasing all materials that go into builds, including client-specified items (fixtures, freezers, specialty components outlined in proposals); purchasing may be delegated to the appropriate associate responsible for that area
* Build and maintain project timelines with clear milestones; manage multiple concurrent projects without letting any fall through
* Shuffle schedules as needed to hit deadlines without sacrificing quality
* Walk the shop floor daily — coach, train, and hold shop staff accountable to the standard
* Read each project correctly: know when it's a craftsmanship-first job and when it's an efficiency-first job, and direct execution accordingly
* Hire in-shop labor and source outside or temporary labor when needed; post jobs on Indeed; the Director of Builds and Director of Events will aid in qualifying candidates and the interview process within their respective divisions
* Go into the field to coordinate vendors and staff for on-site builds and installations
* Retrieve Certificates of Insurance (COIs) for event days and deliver them to clients
* Handle client communications: final proof approvals, sign-offs, pre- and post-project correspondence, repeat order requests, and add-ons
* After 90 days: responsible for quoting add-ons and estimating time and cost for additional work

**Scheduling & Project Management**

* Own Monday.com entirely — keep all project schedules current, accurate, and useful
* Make the schedule the single source of truth for the sales team to understand current capacity
* Use the schedule to make real decisions: when to bring in temp labor, when to push back on a new project, when to hire
* Pre-plan thoroughly on every project before work begins — identify every aspect, account for shipping and logistics timelines, ensure all parts arrive before they're needed
* Escalate risks early — scope gaps, schedule slips, material lead times, labor constraints, and site constraints must be surfaced to leadership immediately, not after they become problems
* No client commitments on scope, pricing, schedule changes, or change orders without prior alignment and approval from leadership

**Cost Optimization & Pricing (Develops Over Time)**

* Conduct cost-up analysis using the company margin pricing structure
* Track actual shop time — how long it takes to manufacture specific parts — to sharpen future estimates
* Advise on the most cost-effective production methods (laminating options, fabrication approaches, sourcing decisions)
* Over time: help advise on project pricing and assist in preparing proposals for the sales team
* Understand where the threshold is between maximizing margin and pricing out of a job

**Documentation & Process Improvement**

* Leverage AI tools to help generate, standardize, and document shop and install processes (SOPs, checklists, templates) so work is repeatable and scalable
* Identify shop processes that can be improved — recommend equipment, tools, or machinery that would benefit the team
* Identify what work is better to outsource versus keep in-house
* Source materials: acrylics, plywood, ACM (aluminum composite material), glass, and any custom materials specified by clients
* Stay current on new materials and suppliers that can improve quality or reduce cost

**ONBOARDING**

The first 30 days include intensive hands-on training with both the Builds Director and Creative Director. You will be immersed in active projects, existing processes, client relationships, and shop operations so you can take full ownership as quickly as possible. We invest heavily in your onboarding — we expect the same commitment in return.

**PROBATION PERIOD**

**30-Day Check-In**

You should be handling projects end-to-end, building trust with the team, and demonstrating measurable value in your role. Leadership will have a direct, honest conversation with you about what's working and what needs to shift.

**90-Day Formal Review**

At 90 days, a formal performance review will be conducted. Leadership will evaluate overall project execution, team integration, quality of work, and contribution to business operations. This review shapes the direction of your continued employment and compensation.

**HOW WE'LL MEASURE YOUR SUCCESS (Ongoing KPIs)**

* Projects delivered on time and on budget, consistently
* Pre-planning discipline: every project aspect identified and addressed before work begins — lead times accounted for, logistics locked down, nothing caught off guard mid-project
* Net-positive contribution to profit margin
* Shop floor performance: team hitting quality standards, production running efficiently
* Monday.com accuracy: schedule always current and visible to the sales team in real time
* Quality of documentation and SOPs produced
* Client satisfaction on communications and deliverables

**WORKING CONDITIONS**

* This role is based in our Los Angeles shop and requires daily on-site presence
* Field work is required — you will periodically go on-site to coordinate installs and vendor setups
* During tight project timelines, some late days may be required; however, with appropriate scheduling and pre-planning this should be the exception, not the rule
* Occasional nights and weekends may be required for installs — this is part of the job
* Must be comfortable being hands-on during crunch periods
* Must follow all shop and jobsite safety rules, including PPE requirements at all times
* Must be physically able to lift and move materials and tools as needed for fabrication and installs

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

* Background in fabrication, construction, production, or event production — with demonstrated experience leading operational work, not just supporting it
* Comfortable in a shop environment and in the field; able to hold a team accountable to quality standards
* Able to juggle multiple active projects simultaneously without losing detail
* Financially aware — understands margin, cost-up analysis, and is motivated to protect profitability
* Computer literate; able to work efficiently on Mac OS to run programs, create documentation, and keep systems organized
* Efficient, accurate typist with strong written communication skills
* Able to communicate clearly and professionally with clients and internal teams via email and text
* Works effectively across all teams; communicates with clarity, professionalism, and good judgment
* Level-headed, logical decision-maker who maintains composure and integrity in high-pressure situations
* Comfortable leveraging AI tools to improve documentation and operational efficiency

**CONFIDENTIALITY & INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY**

All client information, pricing, designs, processes, and internal business data must be kept strictly confidential during and after employment. All work product created in the course of employment — including plans, documentation, build methods, templates, SOPs, and checklists — is the sole property of The Simple Luxe.

**COMPENSATION & BENEFITS**

* Salary: $71,000/year to $90,000/year
* Employment Type: Full-time, salaried, exempt
* Mileage Reimbursement: Provided for all approved work-related travel
* Per Diem: Provided for field/travel work; amount based on job type and complexity
* Vacation: 3 days annually, beginning after the 90-day probation period; unused days carry over up to a maximum of 6 days accumulated over two years (negotiable)
* Bonus: Bonus opportunities may be offered based on individual performance and overall business results. Any bonus program is discretionary, subject to change, and is not earned until paid. Eligibility requirements apply at the time of payout.
* 401(k): Available
* PTO: Available per company policy

**HOW TO APPLY**

Send your resume and a brief description — two to five sentences — of a project you managed end-to-end. Tell us what the project was, what your role was, and how you handled it when something didn't go according to plan.

Email: thesimpleluxebuilds@gmail.com

Title: Behavioral Health Program Manager
Description:
**The Village Life Center | Houston, TX**

**Job Type:** Full-time  
**Compensation:** $55,000–$63,000 annually, commensurate with qualifications and experience  
**Work Setting:** In-person

If you are an experienced behavioral health professional who is passionate about quality client care, operational excellence and supporting a strong clinical team, we encourage you to apply.

### **About Us:**

The Village Life Center is a community-based behavioral health organization dedicated to improving the lives of children, adolescents, adults and families through comprehensive mental health rehabilitation, case management and supportive services.

We are seeking an experienced, organized and proactive Behavioral Health Program Manager to join our Houston leadership team and support the delivery of high-quality, compliant and person-centered behavioral health services.

### **About the Position:**

The Program Manager works closely with the Clinical Director to oversee the day-to-day operations of our Mental Health Rehabilitation and Targeted Case Management programs, ensuring service quality, continuity of care, regulatory compliance and effective coordination among providers, clients, families and community partners.

The ideal candidate has a strong understanding of Texas Medicaid behavioral health services, exceptional organizational skills and the ability to effectively manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced behavioral health professional looking to advance their leadership career while remaining connected to meaningful client care.

### **Key Responsibilities:**

**Program Management & Quality Assurance:**

* Oversee daily program workflows to ensure efficient and effective service delivery.
* Review service documentation for accuracy, quality, timeliness and compliance with agency and payer requirements.
* Monitor client intakes, initial contacts, service utilization and program performance.
* Manage service authorizations and reauthorizations to support continuity of care.
* Identify and address documentation deficiencies, service delivery concerns and compliance issues.
* Assist with quality assurance initiatives, audit preparation and resolution of claims-related concerns.

**Treatment Planning & Care Coordination:**

* Complete CANS and ANSA assessments in accordance with applicable requirements.
* Develop and monitor individualized, measurable treatment plans, crisis plans and discharge plans within the scope of professional qualifications.
* Coordinate required clinical reviews and approvals with the Clinical Director.
* Collaborate with treatment team members to ensure services align with client needs and treatment goals.
* Serve as a liaison between psychiatric providers, treatment team members, clients and families to support medication management and continuity of care.
* Support client engagement, follow-up and coordination of community resources.

**Program Leadership & Service Delivery:**

* Provide guidance and support to behavioral health providers regarding documentation, treatment planning and service delivery expectations.
* Maintain effective communication with families, caregivers, referral sources and community stakeholders.
* Collaborate with clinical and executive leadership on program initiatives and performance improvement.
* Provide direct mental health rehabilitation and case management services as needed and within the scope of professional qualifications.
* Maintain current knowledge of Texas Medicaid requirements and behavioral health best practices.

### **Required Qualifications:**

* Meet Texas credentialing requirements for a Qualified Mental Health Professional–Community Services (QMHP-CS).
* Minimum of three years of behavioral health experience, including at least two years of experience with Texas Medicaid Mental Health Rehabilitation and/or Targeted Case Management services.
* At least one year of leadership, supervisory or program coordination experience.
* Knowledge of Texas Medicaid service requirements, authorizations, treatment planning and clinical documentation standards.
* CANS and ANSA certifications, or ability to obtain required certifications prior to administering assessments.
* Strong leadership, organizational, communication and problem-solving skills.
* Proficiency with electronic medical records and standard office technology.
* Ability to successfully complete required background and credentialing screenings.

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Master's degree in psychology, social work, counseling or a related human services field.
* Experience providing behavioral health services to children and adolescents
* Familiarity with Superior HealthPlan, STAR Health and other Texas Medicaid managed care organizations.
* Experience with Medicaid audits, quality assurance and compliance monitoring.
* Familiarity with Notenetic or comparable behavioral health electronic medical record systems.
* Bilingual English/Spanish preferred

### **Compensation & Benefits:**

* Competitive annual compensation based on experience and qualifications.
* Employer-sponsored medical, dental, vision insurance with employer medical insurance premium contributions.
* Paid time off.
* Paid holidays.
* Professional growth and leadership development opportunities.
* Opportunity to make a meaningful impact through community-based behavioral health services.

### **Join Our Team:**

If you are an experienced behavioral health professional who is passionate about quality client care, operational excellence and supporting a strong clinical team, we encourage you to apply.

Learn more about The Village Life Center at www.villagelifecenter.com.

The Village Life Center is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

* Leads the Public Health & Emergency Services employee engagement activities through the development and implementation of the department’s internal communications strategy, identifying engagement opportunities for staff at all levels.
* Ensures the implementation and evaluation of relevant elements of the Public Health & Emergency Services strategic plan
* Participates in Senior Leadership Team meetings, advising the Medical Officer of Health, Associate Medical Officers of Health, the Public Health Chief of Staff, Chief of Emergency Medical Services, and Directors on strategic business decisions, and confidential or sensitive issues
* Ensure all policies and standards related to communications, community outreach, and employee engagement are successfully incorporated, understood, and communicated

Title: Senior Delivery Manager
Description:
**\*\* This role is not eligible for sponsorship AND is four days onsite hybrid at our N. Scottsdale office \*\***

**The Opportunity**

We're looking for a Senior Manager of Delivery Management to lead a team of Delivery Managers who help product teams overcome obstacles and deliver effectively. You are accountable for your team's performance and for demonstrating how Delivery Management support improves delivery. You work with Product, Engineering, and internal partners to agree on meaningful measures of success, establish a starting point, and use results to guide action.

You are expected to notice problems and opportunities, speak up, and take action. Stay close to your Delivery Managers, Technology and Product leaders, and business partners to understand what is working and where teams need better support or tooling. Turn what you learn into clear actions informed by data and feedback, and follow through on your team's commitments.

Delivery Management works as part of the broader Technology Delivery and Engineering Enablement org, which brings together delivery support, engineering practices, workflow capabilities, investment and capacity information, and performance insights. You involve the right leaders when a solution crosses functional or team boundaries.

Delivery Manager support may focus on a product area, a problem spanning several products or product groups, a mission team, or a High Integrity Commitment. You recognize where support will help and when it should change or end. Product Managers retain product and business responsibilities, Tech Leads retain technical decisions and delivery accountability, and product teams retain their commitments. Delivery Managers help reduce process and tooling inefficiencies that prevent teams from delivering effectively.

For example, a Delivery Manager identifies recurring delays. You bring together the appropriate leaders in the broader Technology Delivery and Engineering Enablement org to examine the data and address the causes, which may involve automation or a new capability. The team and Delivery Manager assess whether delivery improves. You ensure actions have owners and unresolved issues reach the accountable leaders who can address them.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Build and lead the team.** Lead recruiting, onboarding, coaching, and performance management. Set expectations for each Delivery Manager level, give regular feedback, and build development and succession plans. Encourage peer learning and share approaches that work, adapting practices to the problem. Recommend hiring, promotion, termination, and staffing decisions for supervisor review and approval.

**Set direction for your team.** Translate department priorities into team goals and work plans. Agree objectives with your supervisor and plan staffing, assignments, and development needs over the next 6-12 months. Review progress and adjust plans as needs change.

**Provide support where it adds value.** Work with Product and Engineering leaders to understand support needs. Match assignments to each Delivery Manager's experience, skills, and available capacity. Resolve competing requests within agreed priorities and staffing. Bring decisions about additional capacity or changes in direction to your supervisor.

**Make responsibilities clear.** Agree on the problems to address, support needed, expected results, and delivery success metrics with Product and Technology leaders and internal customers. Review results with those partners, your team, and your supervisor to determine whether more help is needed or support should move elsewhere, be reduced, or end. Coach Delivery Managers to spot problems early while leaving routine coordination with the teams and leads closest to the work.

**Own your team's results.** Set clear performance expectations for Delivery Managers and assess their effectiveness using agreed metrics and outcomes, supported by data and feedback from internal customers and Product and Engineering leaders. Challenge updates that describe activity without showing progress. Address signs that delivery support is becoming ongoing ownership of team ceremonies, routine project coordination, or project management office oversight. When work stalls, understand why, address the issue, and make sure the next action and owner are clear.

**Resolve issues that need leadership.** Help Delivery Managers address problems beyond their authority or experience. Bring the right decision-makers together and follow through on agreed actions. Handle day-to-day team decisions independently. Seek guidance on complex assignments, competing department priorities, or decisions beyond your authority; obtain supervisor approval for strategic decisions affecting team objectives.

**Turn recurring problems into shared improvements.** Use data and feedback to identify repeated delays and unnecessary effort. Challenge practices that are not helping and bring recommendations to leaders who own or are affected by the issue. Establish a starting point, then agree on improvement actions, owners, expected results, and timing. Follow through to determine whether changes helped, adjust when needed, and raise unresolved issues.

**Work as one organization.** Regularly speak with Product and Engineering leaders and your peers in the broader Technology Delivery and Engineering Enablement org. Understand where teams are succeeding and where support could help. Hold Delivery Managers accountable for sharing findings and opportunities and involving the appropriate leaders in solutions. Each functional leader retains ownership of their team's capabilities and tools.

**Coordinate Delivery Manager and Program Management support.** Work with Program Management leadership when assignments need sustained technical planning and coordination, including operational work or work outside the Product Operating Model. Make responsibilities clear when someone serves in a Delivery Manager or Program Management capacity, and when that assignment changes.

**Make delivery information reliable and useful.** Hold Delivery Managers accountable for working with teams and information owners to keep needed information accurate, current, and available in agreed tools such as Jira. Use existing information before asking for separate updates. Work with system owners and affected leaders when information is missing or hard to capture, find, or interpret. Partner with the broader Technology Delivery and Engineering Enablement org to establish consistent definitions, reliable data sources, and practical reporting for the agreed key performance indicators (KPIs). Ensure results are shared and reviewed with internal customers and appropriate leaders to guide decisions and improvement actions.

**Contribute to staffing and budget plans.** Contribute staffing and development needs to budget planning with the appropriate leaders in the broader Technology Delivery and Engineering Enablement org. Manage assignments within approved staffing and funding, and apply company policies consistently.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

***Employment Experience***

  

* At least 7 years of experience in delivery management, program management, or related software delivery roles, plus at least 2 years of staff-management experience.
* Experience hiring, coaching, reviewing performance, and developing delivery professionals supporting multiple product teams or product areas.
* Experience working with empowered product teams and understanding how Product Operating Model delivery support differs from operational or other program management.

***Technical Skills***

**Technical Acumen**

* Strong understanding of software delivery from discovery through development, release, and production support. Able to coach Delivery Managers and have useful conversations with engineering leaders. No coding required.
* Working knowledge of iterative and continuous delivery, technical dependencies, release readiness, and program coordination. Able to choose an approach that fits the work.
* Proficiency in Jira and Confluence. Able to explain information, workflow, and automation needs to tool owners and use delivery information to support decisions.

**AI & Agentic Delivery Practices**

* Effective use of everyday AI tools such as Claude, Microsoft Copilot, and ChatGPT for research, communication, analysis, and delivery work. Able to coach the team on responsible use.
* Understanding of AI-enabled and agentic delivery practices. Able to spot useful automation opportunities, assess whether they help, and support the team in learning new tools and practices.
* Working knowledge of AI-DLC practices and guardrails. Able to identify adoption problems and work with Engineering and the broader Technology Delivery and Engineering Enablement org on improvements.

**Delivery Rigor, Lean Process & Flow Metrics**

* Experience setting team goals and work plans, balancing support demand and capacity, and matching assignments to people's skills.
* Experience using root-cause analysis, continuous improvement, and flow measures such as cycle time, throughput, work in progress, and aging work to understand problems and assess improvements.
* Able to agree on meaningful KPIs with internal customers, partners, and the broader Technology Delivery and Engineering Enablement org to assess Delivery Manager effectiveness and demonstrate measurable delivery improvements.

***Additional Skills & Competencies***

* You've managed and developed delivery professionals. You can explain how your hiring, coaching, and performance decisions helped people work more effectively and independently.
* You take ownership. You raise concerns early, bring practical recommendations, and follow through. You are comfortable challenging an approach, having a difficult conversation, and holding people accountable for agreed actions.
* You understand empowered product teams and know when support will help and when it would take ownership away from their leaders.
* You make sound decisions when there is no established solution. You investigate the problem, use data and evidence to test your understanding, weigh the options, and know when to seek guidance or approval.
* You can balance competing support needs, explain your decisions, and change course when the situation changes.
* You build relationships with other leaders, recognize what is working, and turn shared problems and opportunities into action. You develop your team's judgment rather than becoming the person who solves every difficult problem.

**Collaboration & Communication**

Title: Sr. Manager, Project Management, Technology Delivery
Description:
**RS Function:** Technology  
**Reports To:** Head of Business Strategy, Risk Management, and Compliance

**NANDO'S VISION**

At Nando's, we want to be the most loved restaurant brand in North America, sharing the spirit of Nando's PERi-PERi with everyone who chooses to access it. We will redesign and build a business that thrives as it answers fully to its consumers' needs—and endures over time through genuinely putting people at the heart of what we do. We will lead with our values and act with care, compassion, and kindness. By doing this, we will Change Lives Together, every day and everywhere.

**ROLE SUMMARY**

For a scaling business that is preparing to enter a phase of growth, an effective and efficient program management office (PMO) is essential. Project management at Nando's has been strategically embedded into key disciplines: construction administration, technology enablement, and enterprise delivery. These three PMs work together in close coordination to drive our business priorities ahead and land them brilliantly.

As the principal technology delivery PM and key member of the USA Technology organization, you will work closely with the Head of Business Strategy, Risk Management, and Compliance and key business partners both in the USA and around the Nando's World (UK, South Africa, Australia) to execute the USA Technology Roadmap and ensure flawless rollouts and execution in-restaurant. Most major technology initiatives require strong coordination and precise operational execution. You will be responsible to think quickly, be creative, remove blockers, and drive our tech agenda forward to deliver cutting edge solutions for our customers and teams. You will need to take a restaurant first approach to technology – listening to our operators, addressing their concerns and managing issues as they arise – by finding creative solutions to real-time challenges.

**CORE FOCUS AREAS**

*Administer the Nando's USA Technology Roadmap*

The first horizon (est. 12-18 months) USA Technology Roadmap has been established and kicked off. You will take over responsibility for administering execution, managing schedule, budget, dependencies, and risks across the +/- 12 interdependent workstreams.

*Drive Operations Adoption and Exceptional Delivery/Execution in Restaurants*  
You will be an Operations business partner and be responsible for working directly with the USA Ops Director and Market Managing Directors to align schedule/delivery with operational readiness and execution. You will serve as the technology liaison to Operations and ensure the field is ready for implementations.

*Monitor Budget and Schedule Considerations, Dependencies, and Risk Factors*

Working closely with the MD Technology and your finance business partner, you will oversee the technology department budget. You will be responsible for aligning capex requests to expected spend periods and monitoring accruals/rollover. You will report on budget status and re-forecast for accuracy and schedule alignment.

*Represent Technology within the USA Enterprise Flight Plan Delivery + Implementation Group*

You will be the voice of Technology within the USA Enterprise Flight Plan working group. You'll report tech initiatives out to the broader organization and ensure tech milestones/dependencies/conflicts are accurately surfaced and resolved.

*Balance Bold Ambition with Practical Realities*  
You will be on the front line of an ambitious agenda. Your role will be to balance aggressive ambition with practical reality and ensure the field and your counterparts are ready for the change before it hits. You'll chart out the direction of travel with the tech team and ensure it's clearly communicated across the business.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Build a nimble rollout/delivery infrastructure. Agree the scope, budget, and measures of success. Group restaurants into rollout waves that account for trading patterns, equipment lead times, engineer availability and dependencies between teams. Create the tools and materials needed to replicate rollouts well across the business.
* Connect the plan to the field. Coordinate site surveys with Operations and installation partners where required. Turn the findings into a plan for each restaurant, confirming what needs to be ordered, configured or resolved before engineers arrive. Ensure comms plans are market-specific and that the field remains informed and aligned with approach.
* Manage suppliers and logistics. Coordinate hardware procurement, deliveries and engineer bookings so the right people and equipment arrive at the right restaurant. Track supplier commitments and arrange the collection and processing of replaced hardware.
* Own change control around live trading. Agree installation windows with restaurant teams, including overnight work where needed. Before work starts, confirm who can authorize the change, how engineers and operating teams will test it, and when to switch to the fallback plan if trading is at risk.
* Manage the budget and report progress. Track purchase orders, actual spend and forecasts. Give stakeholders a clear view of which restaurants are ready, where costs or dates are at risk and which decisions need their attention.
* See each installation through to handover. Agree what a successful installation looks like with the restaurant manager and support teams. Confirm the equipment works in service, agree who owns support after go-live and make sure operating teams know how to get help. Give outstanding issues a defined owner and follow them through to resolution.
* Continually improve. Use feedback from restaurant teams and engineers to refine surveys, installation instructions and scheduling. Where an issue causes delays or repeat visits, address the cause before the next wave.

**SUCCESS CRITERIA**

Success in this role means:

* The Nando's USA technology roadmap is accurately managed, executed, and delivered  
  against the desired time horizons.
* Leadership has one integrated view of priorities, capacity, risks, and dependencies in the technology space, and uses it to make resourcing decisions.
* Strategic initiatives are delivered on time and within scope, with benefits tracked and reviewed after launch.
* Critical rollouts and systemwide tech delivery projects move through a clear, repeatable execution path.
* Technology is viewed as a center of excellence for Nando's USA and is an accelerator to our success. You deliver exceptional implementations without friction or frustration and work with your partners to continually improve.

Requirements:

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* 5–7 years of relevant experience in technology project management, technology delivery, or complex cross-functional implementations.
* Experience personally leading a technology rollout across multiple live locations from planning and procurement through to implementation and handover. Your background could be in hospitality, retail, banking branches or another environment where teams need to keep serving customers through a change.
* Experience managing technology changes in a live, customer-facing environment. You've agreed change windows with operational teams, coordinated technical and user testing, and put a workable fallback in place. You've also agreed who takes ownership after go-live and followed outstanding issues through to resolution.
* Experience coordinating third-party suppliers, field engineers and equipment logistics across several locations. You can recognize when a site isn't ready, bring the right people together and adjust the plan before an engineer is dispatched.
* Confidence managing project budgets, forecasting costs and explaining the options when dates, resources or supplier commitments change.
* Clear, considerate communication. You can give a busy restaurant manager the information they need for tomorrow's opening and help senior stakeholders make a timely decision about the wider rollout.
* Experience with core restaurant technology, including point of sale (POS) hardware and software systems, kitchen management systems (KMS), payment terminals, restaurant-specific hardware and software tools, etc. We're particularly interested in hearing about a rollout you owned, the decisions you made and how you knew the teams using the technology were ready to take it on.

**WORK ARRANGEMENT**  
This role is based in Washington, D.C. and requires a strong in-person presence to lead cross functional collaboration, mentor teams, and engage directly with key stakeholders.

**YOUR FIRST 90 DAYS**

The first 90 days of your employment will be a mutual onboarding and learning period, where both you and Nando's ensure you are set up for success in the role and that expectations are clear and aligned. We'll connect regularly to review progress, provide support, and ensure you have what you need to succeed. Employment with Nando's always remains at-will.

At Nando's, we believe in offering competitive pay that reflects the value you bring, the impact you'll  
make on our team, and the local market.

Title: Head of Customer Success & Professional Services
Program Controls Advisory Services Manager
Description:
When you care deeply about the work you do, it’s rewarding to see it through from concept to completion. We partner with clients to provide both program management and construction management to strategize, plan, and implement projects that drive organizations forward. From hospitals and airports to university campuses, mass transit systems, water treatment facilities, mines, and wind farms, we've successfully managed thousands of projects.

Joining our team, turning visionary ideas into reality, will shape your future—and the future of your community.

We are strategizing, planning, and implementing projects that help clients achieve their organization’s objectives. Join our award-winning program management team and bring transformational project solutions to life.

Your Opportunity

Stantec is seeking qualified candidates for a Program Controls Advisory Services Manager position. The individual serves as a senior advisor to major capital programs, providing strategic Program Controls leadership during program mobilization, execution, transformation and periods of performance challenge.

The role operates at the intersection of client needs, Program Management and Program Controls, translating client objectives into practical governance, processes, systems, reporting and decision-making frameworks. Unlike a traditional Program Controls Manager focused on day-to-day delivery for one program, this role is deployed where specialized leadership, independent perspective or intervention is required.

The position establishes new controls organizations, assesses and strengthens existing programs, resolves complex delivery issues, improves underperforming controls environments and supports program leadership in restoring confidence, integration and predictability. It also acts as a trusted bridge among the client, PMO, delivery partners, consultants, contractors and internal controls teams.

This position requires prior experience working on an integrated program team with strong knowledge and hands-on experience in developing baseline project budgets and schedules; monitoring and tracking the progress of project work relative to established budgets and schedules; preparation of project budget and schedule status reports and presentations; working with Program/Project Managers to proactively identify project budget and schedule problems and implement corrective actions; and preparation of cost accruals, estimates to complete and estimates at completion.

Qualified candidates understand the process of administering the non-technical elements of large projects that are tied together for the successful delivery of a program. They are comfortable developing and maintaining procedures that help streamline project controls processes and provide mentorship to other project controls specialists and team members. They possess emotional intelligence and prioritize establishing and maintaining trusting relationships and close partnerships with Program/Project Managers, other team members and supporting them in serving the client and meeting established goals to achieve success

Your Key Responsibilities

Program Mobilization and Setup

* Advise clients and program leadership on fit-for-purpose Program Controls operating models for major capital programs.
* Develop governance frameworks for cost, schedule, risk, change, forecasting, funding, performance measurement and reporting.
* Establish integrated WBS, CBS, OBS, control accounts, coding structures, baselines, calendars, reporting cycles, roles, responsibilities and approval authorities.
* Develop Program Controls Plans, procedures, SOPs, workflows, responsibility matrices and reporting standards.
* Evaluate and recommend PMIS, scheduling, cost, risk and business-intelligence solutions, including Primavera P6, Primavera Unifier, e-Builder, Power BI and enterprise ERP platforms.
* Create scalable controls that mature across planning, design, procurement, construction, commissioning and closeout.

Program Controls Advisory

* Serve as a senior advisor to Program Directors, Program Managers, PMO leaders and client executives on program performance and controls strategy.
* Independently assess whether controls are producing reliable information that management can use with confidence.
* Translate complex controls data into executive-level insight on current status, forecast direction, changes, risks and required decisions.
* Challenge ineffective practices and recommend practical improvements aligned with program maturity, complexity, risk profile, contracting strategy and delivery model.

Program Intervention and Issue Resolution

* Rapidly assess controls maturity and identify root causes of performance issues.
* Evaluate schedule quality, cost performance, forecast reliability, risk exposure, change governance, funding alignment and reporting effectiveness.
* Identify breakdowns among cost, schedule, risk, change, funding, contracts and program decision-making.
* Develop and lead targeted recovery and corrective-action plans with clear owners, milestones and performance indicators.
* Resolve unclear ownership, inconsistent processes, disconnected data, reporting gaps and ineffective functional interfaces.
* Stabilize underperforming controls environments and remain engaged long enough to embed sustainable improvements.

Client Services and Client Advocacy

* Serve as a trusted advisor between the client and the program delivery organization.
* Understand client objectives, funding constraints, governance requirements, risk tolerance and performance expectations.
* Translate client needs into clear, actionable requirements for the PMO and delivery teams.
* Facilitate difficult conversations involving performance, forecast changes, schedule delays, risk exposure, funding constraints and delivery challenges.
* Provide an objective perspective where client expectations and delivery realities are not aligned.
* Build trust through transparent, data-driven advice while maintaining productive stakeholder relationships.

Program Performance and Integration

Promote an integrated management environment in which Scope -> Schedule -> Cost -> Funding -> Risk -> Change -> Forecast -> Decision operate as a connected system.

* Ensure cost forecasts reflect schedule progression, approved changes and known risks.
* Ensure schedule forecasts consider procurement, funding, contractor capacity and delivery constraints.
* Connect quantified risk exposure with contingency and management reserve strategies.
* Improve consistency between project-level and program-level reporting.
* Develop forward-looking indicators that identify emerging issues before they become significant performance problems.

Governance and Program Assurance

* Conduct health checks and maturity assessments of Program Controls organizations.
* Assess compliance with procedures and governance expectations, including gaps between documented and actual practices.
* Establish escalation thresholds, decision rights and approval authorities.
* Support executive governance forums with concise, decision-oriented performance information.
* Review data quality and reporting reliability before information is elevated to client executives.
* Support independent program reviews, recovery initiatives and performance-improvement efforts.

Leadership and Capability Building

* Mentor Program Controls Managers and professionals across cost, schedule, risk, change, forecasting and reporting disciplines.
* Coach program leadership on using controls information for timely decisions.
* Establish clear interfaces among PMO leadership, controls functions, delivery teams and clients.
* Build collaborative multidisciplinary teams and reduce functional silos.
* Develop repeatable standards, frameworks, templates and leading practices for deployment across programs.
* Plan knowledge transfer so improvements remain with the program after the advisory engagement ends.

Typical Engagements

* A new multi-year capital program needs its controls organization established.
* A PMO is being formed, reorganized or transitioned.
* A client needs an independent assessment of Program Controls.
* Forecasts or schedules are not credible, consistent or decision-ready.
* Projects report differently, preventing program-level visibility.
* Risk, contingency, funding and change are disconnected from cost and schedule.
* Leadership does not trust dashboards or performance reporting.
* Systems are fragmented, overly complex or underutilized.
* Client and Program Management expectations have become misaligned.
* A program requires stabilization, turnaround, recovery or knowledge transfer.

The successful candidate should:

* Demonstrate strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Have the demonstrated ability to encourage and facilitate collaboration and cooperation amongst diverse team members
* Schedule and lead coordination meetings
* Work in a manner to ensure personal safety and that of fellow employees by following company health and safety guidelines and policies.
* Consistently adhere to Company processes and policies including business conduct, cyber-security, safety and personal conduct.

It is expected the successful candidate will have the following qualifications:

* Combination of a degree from an accredited institution in an applicable field or documented experience specific to program controls
* BA/BS Engineering, Construction Management, Business, Finance, Project Management or a related discipline.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification is preferred
* Additional certifications, PgMP, PMI-SP, PMI-RMP, PMI-CP, CPA, CCM, PE, FE, or similar certifications is preferred
* A minimum of 15 years’ progressive experience supporting complex capital programs, including substantial Program/Project Controls leadership experience infrastructure/buildings/utility/water programs is required
* Familiarity with various project delivery methods, including Design Bid Build, Progressive Design Build, CMAR, and Design Build.
* Demonstrated success establishing, transforming or leading Program Controls functions on major infrastructure or capital programs.
* Strong knowledge of cost management, forecasting, scheduling, risk and opportunity management, change management, funding and cash-flow planning, performance reporting, PMIS/ERP environments and program assurance.
* Experience in the municipal sector in areas of public works, utilities, transportation, and industry and on multi-sector programs is preferred
* Experience in owner, PMCM, consultant, contractor or integrated delivery environments and advising senior client leadership.
* Must be able to demonstrate good interpersonal skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment
* Must demonstrate organizational skills and ability to work on multiple projects simultaneously.
